units.name: b09_read_screen_controller
units.summary: Latch controller 1, serially shift eight bits into the held-button byte; resulting bit order is A=1, B=2, Select=4, Start=8, Up=$10, Down=$20, Left=$40, Right=$80.
units.scope: Classified fragments within this envelope; intervening unknown bytes remain unknown.

units.name: b08_enter_screen_bank
units.summary: Disable rendering and IRQs, clear palette/nametable/sprite staging, install screen NMI/IRQ vectors, then jump through the 19-entry screen selector table. Effective CPU slots are banks8/9/14/15; selector handlers are statically supported, not all naturally visited.

units.name: b08_show_timed_screen
units.summary: Build the selected screen, enable rendering, wait and fade its first palette group in/out, then stop the sound request and disable display through the shared exit.

units.name: b08_show_scrolling_text
units.summary: Initialize the scrolling text pointer, palette and mirroring; fade in, scroll until Start or the terminal record aborts the helper's caller, then fade out.

units.name: b08_scroll_text_until_start
units.summary: Synchronize one scroll step to the NMI counter, wrap Y at240 while toggling nametable, and prepare another centered text row at each32-pixel boundary. Stage14 suppresses Start cancellation.

units.name: b08_prepare_centered_text_row
units.summary: Choose one of16 row destinations from vertical scroll and nametable parity. Scan an FF-terminated character row, calculate padding to32 tiles, and expand paired top/bottom glyphs into RAM. FE discards this call's return address and returns from the scrolling loop; it is deliberately nonlocal control flow.

units.name: b08_upload_centered_text_row
units.summary: Upload both glyph halves with leading/trailing blank padding to a32-tile row destination; advance the text pointer past its FF terminator. Buffers and padding counts must have been prepared by the row builder.

units.name: b08_show_stage_tally
units.summary: Draw stage, score, resource counters and timer. Convert the two saved resource counts and remaining time into decimal score with short request/acknowledgement pauses, then award a life when the threshold digit changes. Display identity beyond these mechanics remains tentative.

units.name: b08_tally_first_resource
units.summary: Consume the first resource counter one unit at a time, adding one at score digit2 and requesting its redraw. Wait for display acknowledgement plus four NMI ticks between steps.

units.name: b08_tally_second_resource
units.summary: Consume the second resource counter one unit at a time, adding one at score digit3 and requesting its redraw with the same pacing.

units.name: b08_tally_remaining_time
units.summary: Consume timer high units or tens/ones of its low component, adding scaled values into the score digits. Request timer/score redraw after each transfer until both timer bytes are zero.

units.name: b08_wait_tally_redraw
units.summary: Wait for the signed display request acknowledgement, then wait four screen interrupt ticks before the next tally step. Interrupt service must remain enabled.

units.name: b08_add_decimal_score
units.summary: Add A to decimal digit X in the seven-digit score array, reduce modulo10 and propagate carries toward lower indices. Caller supplies a valid digit index and bounded increment.

units.name: b08_show_three_text_notice
units.summary: Draw text records26..28, enable rendering, fade in, wait up to five seconds with Start cancellation, then fade out and exit.

units.name: b08_initialize_options_screen
units.summary: Reset the music/effect selectors and option row, draw option text, button assignments, difficulty and numeric selections, enable rendering and fade in before polling.

units.name: b08_poll_options
units.summary: Request selected-row redraw and wait for acknowledgement. Ignore held input while empty; directional and action bits select the option controls below.

units.name: b08_options_down
units.summary: Down increments the selected option row unless already at row4. Up decrements unless already at row0. The shared refresh path submits request43 after row movement.

units.name: b08_options_left_gate
units.summary: Left on row3 enters the hidden-stage operation. Otherwise control continues through the sound/display pacing path before polling again; exact unlock use remains uncertain.

units.name: b08_options_start_dispatch
units.summary: Start chooses the highlighted option action; hidden-mode state and the A/B combination gate a special route. The configured button masks and selector bytes remain ordinary RAM state.

units.name: b08_options_request_refresh
units.summary: Submit sound request43, fade out and leave the option screen through the shared exit. The request is accepted only while the signed mailbox is empty.

units.name: b08_options_select_dispatch
units.summary: Dispatch by row: swap action masks1/2, cycle difficulty modulo3, or submit the selected music/effect request. Polling and redraw preserve row state.

units.name: b08_options_next_sound
units.summary: Offset the effect selector by15 before submitting its sound request. The request number is a sound-bank command, not a text record.

units.name: b08_options_reset_request
units.summary: Submit the zero sound command, increment the music selection modulo13 and request the shared option redraw.

units.name: b08_options_other_reset_request
units.summary: Submit zero sound command, increment the effect selection modulo36 and use the shared option redraw path.

units.name: b08_options_hidden_stage
units.summary: When hidden-mode enable and A/B permit, reduce the effect selector modulo14 and store the stage index. This establishes the stage-selection mechanics, not a confirmed natural unlock route.

units.name: b08_show_stage_introduction
units.summary: Choose day/night text from stage parity, draw the stage numeral and stage-specific record pair, then fade in and hold up to five seconds before the shared exit.

units.name: b08_show_short_notice_one
units.summary: Draw text record35, enable rendering and fade for a two-second Start-cancellable wait. The next selector uses the same display recipe.

units.name: b08_show_short_notice_two
units.summary: Draw text record36, fade in, wait up to two seconds or Start, fade out and use the shared display exit.

units.name: b08_show_short_notice_three
units.summary: Draw text record40 and use the same two-second fade/wait/exit sequence. Screen identity remains uncertain.

units.name: b08_show_scrolled_text_panel
units.summary: Draw text records41..49 and install alternate NMI8F6C, set a horizontal scroll offset, fade in and hold for seven timer units before fading out. Its installed NMI writes only CHR registers0..5 before restoring saved registers and RTI; exact presentation remains tentative.

units.name: b08_show_attract_and_prepare_demo
units.summary: Render the selected screen and blink an interrupt-driven prompt for up to17 intervals. Start exits early; otherwise enable demo playback, rotate one of four stage/input-script pairs and restore default action masks before exiting.

units.name: b08_show_two_screen_sequence_one
units.summary: Draw two consecutive screen selectors, clear the second nametable attribute block, send sound request1, then switch the nametable after a timed pause. Fade out after the second hold.

units.name: b08_show_two_screen_sequence_two
units.summary: Draw consecutive screen selectors and clear attributes before showing the first/second nametables for separate timed holds. Both waits ignore Start, unlike cancellable notice screens.

units.name: b08_show_long_music_screen
units.summary: Render a selected screen, submit sound request12, fade in, hold for15 timer units and fade out. Exact story-screen identity is not asserted.

units.name: b08_show_continue_countdown
units.summary: Show the selected screen, choose a sound request from the saved continue state, then build score/continue text. If enabled, count down9..0 with a redraw each second; Start records acceptance and plays request46. Otherwise wait and exit after fading.

units.name: b08_show_all_group_transition
units.summary: Render the selected panel with horizontal offset249, transition all eight palette groups, hold three cancellable seconds and reverse the transition before exiting.

units.name: b08_show_standard_timed_screen
units.summary: Render a selected panel, fade group0 in, hold three cancellable seconds and fade it out. Exact panel meaning remains unresolved.

units.name: b08_finish_screen_sound
units.summary: Submit zero sound command and wait until the mailbox is acknowledged before disabling display. This waiting loop needs the screen NMI service.

units.name: b08_disable_screen_display
units.summary: Disable interrupts/rendering and clear scroll and mirroring state, then return to the bank-switching caller. Unknown bytes after this return are a separate interval.

units.name: b08_wait_seconds
units.summary: Wait A successive60-tick intervals using the NMI-decremented timer; unlike the adjacent helper, this entry does not poll Start.

units.name: b08_wait_seconds_or_start
units.summary: Wait A successive60-tick intervals. Start returns carry set; ordinary expiration returns carry clear. Shared scratch holds remaining seconds and NMI decrements the timer.

units.name: b08_load_screen_palette
units.summary: Copy32 original palette bytes from the bank8 palette backing and select CHR shadow122. Palette transitions later derive the active colors from this saved copy.

units.name: b08_draw_score_top_panel
units.summary: Render seven decimal score digits as top and bottom glyph rows at PPU2111/2131 using the shared two-tile font lookup. Caller must provide a safe PPU interval.

units.name: b08_draw_score_tally_panel
units.summary: Render the same seven score digits at PPU22B1/22D1 for the tally panel, preserving the two-pass paired-glyph format.

units.name: b08_move_option_marker
units.summary: Look up the new and previous option-row PPU addresses; draw a two-tile vertical marker at the selected row and erase the previous row's marker.

units.name: b08_draw_action_assignments
units.summary: Use bit1 of each configurable action mask to choose paired button glyphs, drawing the two assignments at fixed option-screen positions.

units.name: b08_draw_difficulty_text
units.summary: Difficulty selects a little-endian string pointer. Scan negative-terminated text twice, mapping characters relative to space into top and bottom font tiles at PPU2130/2150.

units.name: b08_draw_effect_number
units.summary: Convert the effect selector to tens and ones by repeated subtraction of10, then render both decimal digits as paired vertical glyphs at PPU21F0/2210.

units.name: b08_draw_music_number
units.summary: Convert the music selector to tens/ones and render two paired vertical digits at PPU2190/21B0. The conversion retains the remainder on the CPU stack between row passes.

units.name: b08_draw_first_resource_count
units.summary: Convert the saved first resource count into two decimal glyphs at PPU2176/2196. Resource identity is unresolved; its tally consumer decrements it into score.

units.name: b08_draw_second_resource_count
units.summary: Convert the saved second resource count into two decimal glyphs at PPU21D6/21F6. This distinct counter feeds the second tally loop.

units.name: b08_draw_tally_timer
units.summary: Draw the timer high digit, separator and two decimal digits of the low component as two font rows at PPU2234/2254. Source representation is the timer contract, not a packed BCD byte.

units.name: b08_draw_continue_number
units.summary: Render the saved continue-state byte as a two-digit number at PPU21F8/2218. Full game interpretation of that counter remains tentative.

units.name: b08_draw_current_stage_number
units.summary: Halve the stage index and offset into numeral glyphs; render its two vertical tiles at PPU20F3/2113. Stage parity is handled by other display choices.

units.name: b08_draw_previous_stage_number
units.summary: Render floor((stage_index-1)/2)+1 through paired font tiles at PPU20EE/210E for the tally panel. Inputs follow the stage-completion calling contract.

units.name: b08_draw_blinking_prompt
units.summary: Use bit0 of the attract counter to choose visible prompt glyphs or blank tiles, writing two eleven-tile rows at PPU22CA/22EA. Glyph meaning is not inferred from numeric tiles alone.

units.name: b08_scrolling_panel_nmi
units.summary: Save A/X/Y, blank rendering and upload the first16 active palette colors, then select MMC3 register0. The continuation starts with X=0 and updates CHR registers0..5, then performs the PPU/timer tail and restores saved A/X/Y before RTI.

units.name: b08_screen_nmi
units.summary: Save A/X/Y, upload32 palette colors and six CHR shadows, service the signed display mailbox, restore scrolling/rendering, update palette effects/controller/timers and tick sound, then restore registers and RTI.

units.name: b08_tick_screen_timer
units.summary: Decrement the nonzero wait timer and increment the screen tick counter. The screen wait loops rely on this interrupt-driven progress.

units.name: b08_hide_screen_sprites
units.summary: Fill the entire256-byte sprite staging page with F8 so sprites are offscreen.

units.name: b08_initialize_screen_palette
units.summary: Fill both32-byte palette arrays with black0F and clear the first four group transition positions. Later callers initialize or operate the other groups separately.

units.name: b08_clear_two_nametables
units.summary: Write2048 zero bytes from PPU2000 using an eight-page loop. Rendering must be disabled or a suitable PPU interval supplied by the caller.

units.name: b08_dispatch_screen_update
units.summary: Interpret signed mailbox requests0..6: redraw a digit, tally resource/timer, centered text, options or blinking prompt. Complete each supported operation by storing FF; negative requests are already idle.

units.name: b08_draw_screen_digit
units.summary: Convert the countdown digit to a paired font glyph at PPU2295/22B5 and acknowledge the signed mailbox with FF.

units.name: b08_draw_indexed_text
units.summary: A selects a little-endian text pointer. Each record starts with a PPU destination then FF-terminated characters, expanded into paired top/bottom font rows one nametable row apart. Extent comes from independently accepted data bounds.

units.name: b08_transition_palette_group
units.summary: High bit of A chooses fade direction and its low bits select a palette group. Step its transition position toward the chosen endpoint with five interrupt ticks between steps; caller must supply a valid group.

units.name: b08_transition_all_groups_in
units.summary: Nonnegative A steps all eight transition positions upward with seven-tick pauses until group0 reaches4. A negative value selects the reverse entry below.

units.name: b08_transition_all_groups_out
units.summary: Step all eight palette positions downward, waiting five ticks each iteration until group0 reaches0. This assumes the caller initialized compatible group positions.

units.name: b08_update_palette_groups
units.summary: Apply each group's transition position to its four-color slice, delegating brightness adjustment to the shared group helper. No PPU writes occur here; active palette RAM changes for the next upload.

units.name: b08_shade_palette_group
units.summary: Position4 copies original colors. Lower positions subtract a brightness lookup and clamp negative results to0F; the upper path adds its lookup, clamps at30 and then rejoins the lower loop. Preserve the actual mixed X/Y indexing on that upper path rather than assuming a symmetric color model.

units.name: b08_build_selected_screen
units.summary: Screen selector chooses parallel destination/source/dimension/tile-bias/CHR/palette tables. Upload64 attribute bytes, copy a rectangular tile area row by row with a constant tile bias, then copy32 palette bytes. All CPU ROM pointers require the bank8/9 display context.

units.name: b08_submit_screen_sound
units.summary: Write A to the signed sound mailbox only when its current value is negative. Busy requests are dropped; the caller must wait for acknowledgement if delivery is required.

units.name: b10_sound_initialize_jump
units.summary: Public sound-bank trampoline for clearing the channel-enable shadow.

units.name: b10_sound_command_jump
units.summary: Public sound-bank trampoline for starting track A on channel X. Effective bank10 must occupy8000; X selects one of four channel-state columns.

units.name: b10_sound_tick_jump
units.summary: Public sound-bank per-channel tick trampoline. Caller supplies channel index X0..3 and retains the sound-bank mapping.

units.name: b10_clear_sound_enable
units.summary: Clear the shared APU enable shadow. Hardware output is synchronized by the channel tick rather than written at this entry.

units.name: b10_start_sound_track
units.summary: Convert track A to a word-table index, enable channel X in the APU mask and reset track/duration/transpose/instrument/envelope cursors. Mark the channel active with a one-tick note so the next update fetches its first event.

units.name: b10_tick_sound_channel
units.summary: Return if inactive; otherwise publish the APU enable mask and current volume/period/duty. X0/1 use pulse register blocks, X2 triangle and X3 noise. Avoid a redundant tonal high-period write to preserve oscillator behavior before advancing software durations.

units.name: b10_advance_sound_duration
units.summary: Clear volume at a note's last gated tick, advance the duration stream and wrap on FF, then decrement note ticks only when a duration event occurs. Fetch a new pattern event at note expiry; otherwise apply modulation unless the base note is the FF rest sentinel.

units.name: b10_fetch_sound_pattern
units.summary: Resolve a pattern through split low/high tables. FF exits to the track stream, where FF supplies a loop cursor and FE disables the channel/volume. Other track bytes can set transpose and instrument bias before choosing the next pattern. This is the observed parser grammar; arbitrary track selections are not asserted safe.

units.name: b10_decode_pitch_slide_command
units.summary: Pattern FD consumes a packed slide amount/delay plus starting and target notes, applying channel transpose to both. Save the advanced cursor and initialize the selected instrument through the common note path.

units.name: b10_decode_rest_event
units.summary: Pattern bytes E0..FF supply a five-bit rest duration, set base noteFF and zero volume, then advance the pattern cursor and initialize note timing. FF itself is intercepted by the pattern-boundary dispatcher before reaching this path.

units.name: b10_decode_instrument_duration_arpeggio
units.summary: Decode optional instrument selection from C0..DF with track instrument bias, optional duration from80..BF, then arpeggio selection from60..7F. Re-read prefixes as required and preserve the exact threshold dispatch; a remaining lower value becomes the transposed note.

units.name: b10_begin_sound_note
units.summary: Transpose and store the note, then decode its four-byte instrument: pulse duty/control, modulation flags, release/duty selector and volume selector. Tonal channels load split period tables; noise copies the note directly to its period byte. Save the consumed pattern cursor.

units.name: b10_initialize_note_effects
units.summary: Reload note ticks and clear envelope/pitch/arpeggio cursors. Split the packed slide parameter into delay and magnitude, derive direction from target pitch, and calculate the release threshold from duration minus the instrument high nibble. If subtraction underflows, disable low-nibble release modulation flags.

units.name: b10_update_envelope_and_slide
units.summary: Resolve volume sequence and advance until FE holds its last value. When the configured slide delay has elapsed, add/subtract the slide magnitude from the16-bit period until crossing the target table value, then snap exactly to that target. Otherwise continue duty/arpeggio processing.

units.name: b10_finish_pitch_slide
units.summary: Snap base note and period to the target and clear slide magnitude, then continue later effects. The period high byte is copied exactly from the table here, unlike initial note setup'sF8 mask.

units.name: b10_apply_pitch_sequence
units.summary: If no slide is active and release timing permits, select a signed pitch-offset sequence.80 restarts its cursor; negative values subtract their magnitude from the16-bit period and positive values add through the original pointer. Shared zero-pageFE/FF is temporary pointer/arithmetic storage.

units.name: b10_update_pulse_duty_sequence
units.summary: Advance the pitch cursor, then for pulse channels decode the instrument's low-nibble duty sequence. FE holds, FF redirects its cursor through the following byte, and ordinary values update the duty shadow. Triangle/noise skip this duty stage.

units.name: b10_update_arpeggio_sequence
units.summary: Instrument bit40 enables a note sequence; bit80 selects its alternate table half. FE holds, FF redirects the sequence cursor. Nonnegative values offset the base note, negative values encode an absolute seven-bit note. Noise uses that value directly; tonal channels reload split period tables.

units.name: b11_map_update_jump
units.summary: Public trampoline for preparing background edge buffers. Bank11 occupies A000 while the8000 slot can be changed to the level data bank.

units.name: b11_auxiliary_update_jump
units.summary: Public trampoline for servicing eight flag-gated actor/effect spawn requests. These requests create ordinary actor records through shared initialization and allocation helpers.

units.name: b11_prepare_background_stream
units.summary: If vertical scrolling requested an update, prepare the horizontal row and vertical column, including attribute-cache patches, then mark buffers ready for the PPU upload consumer.

units.name: b11_prepare_row_stream
units.summary: Choose the near or far map row according to camera-inhibit bit1, expand its metatiles, calculate row destination geometry and update the attribute cache through the shared row patcher.

units.name: b11_prepare_column_stream
units.summary: Choose the near or far map column according to camera-inhibit bit0, expand its metatiles, calculate column geometry and update the attribute cache through the shared column patcher.

units.name: b11_calculate_near_row_destination
units.summary: Derive nametable/row coordinates from PPU control and scroll shadows. Calculate the row split at32 tiles, opposite-nametable wrap address, selected top/bottom tile-buffer half and attribute quadrant/cache index.

units.name: b11_calculate_far_row_destination
units.summary: Calculate the row destination four tile rows behind the current vertical coordinate, wrapping over28 rows. Derive the split length, opposite nametable address and attribute quadrant used by streaming.

units.name: b11_calculate_near_column_destination
units.summary: Derive current nametable column and tile-row parity from scroll shadows, then compute attribute-cache index, PPU attribute address and quadrant selector for the incoming near column.

units.name: b11_calculate_far_column_destination
units.summary: Advance the horizontal tile coordinate32 columns modulo64, deriving opposite-screen column destination and the same quadrant/cache geometry as the near-column entry.

units.name: b11_patch_row_attributes
units.summary: If horizontal scrolling is active, merge each of17 incoming metatile attribute values into its two-bit quadrant of the128-byte nametable attribute shadow. Preserve the other quadrants with masks and stage the touched attribute bytes for the later upload. The repeated unrolled cells follow the same quadrant and nametable-wrap transitions.

units.name: b11_patch_column_attributes
units.summary: If horizontal scrolling is active, merge13 or14 column attributes into the cached two-bit quadrants and stage the changed bytes. Row/quadrant parity chooses the count; wrap cache rows over the28-tile nametable region.

units.name: b11_select_near_column_origin
units.summary: Copy map-origin pointer to the column cursor and enter the common column expander.

units.name: b11_select_far_column_origin
units.summary: Advance map origin16 metatile cells to select the far incoming column, propagating the pointer carry before the common expander.

units.name: b11_select_near_row_origin
units.summary: Copy map origin to the row cursor and enter the unrolled row expander.

units.name: b11_select_far_row_origin
units.summary: Advance the row-source pointer by12 map strides to select the incoming opposite row. The carry-aware repeated addition retains the caller's level layout.

units.name: b11_expand_row_cells
units.summary: Map the level's PRG bank into8000, then expand17 consecutive map-cell indices. Each cell selects an attribute byte and a four-byte tile record, placing top tile pairs in the34-byte row buffer and bottom pairs in its companion. Attribute values are staged in parallel. The unrolled writes preserve the original destination ordering.

units.name: b11_expand_column_metatiles
units.summary: Map the level PRG bank and expand14 map rows into paired28-byte column buffers plus14 attributes. An odd initial tile row skips the first metatile half, and tile output wraps at28 while source cells advance by map stride. Bank shadow changes are intentional output state, not an automatic restore.

units.name: b11_select_map_prg_bank
units.summary: Preserve A on stack while selecting MMC3 register6 and writing A as its bank value; update the selected-register shadow. The caller maintains the PRG-six shadow separately. Values written to the mapper are not physical bank identities.

units.name: b11_decode_stage_map
units.summary: Decode a finite byte stream from work pointer into output pointer. Nonnegative token N copies N+1 literal bytes. Negative tokens supply a signed backward displacement plus a following copy length; zero length terminates. Backreferences copy forward, allowing overlap, and both source/output pointers propagate carries. Caller establishes input/output bounds and mapped source bank; fourteen accepted stage streams have independent endpoint/output checks.

units.name: b11_update_optional_states
units.summary: Service eight optional spawn requests in fixed order. Each handler consumes its flag, prepares the working actor, allocates a free nonplayer slot and publishes fields when capacity permits; the final handler may create several related actors.

units.name: b11_spawn_selected_auxiliary_actor
units.summary: A negative selector means no request. Otherwise map it to type40+index, adjust selected types for difficulty, copy saved coordinates and initialize animation/motion/flags. Allocate and publish an actor when possible, then clear the selector toFF. Allocation failure leaves the selector for a later retry.

units.name: b11_spawn_single_effect_0538
units.summary: Consume flag0538, build type67 from saved coordinates/flags and initialize animation and motion. If allocation succeeds, publish it and request sound25. Game-level effect identity remains uncertain.

units.name: b11_spawn_aimed_effect_053e
units.summary: Consume flag053E, build type67 and compare its position with player coordinates. Quantize horizontal distance into four bands and vertical distance into eight, with sign/facing flags, then choose two motion nibbles from32-entry lookup tables. Publish when a free slot exists and request sound48.

units.name: b11_spawn_vertical_effect_0544
units.summary: Consume flag0544 and prepare type67 at saved coordinates with vertical flag, fixed motion nibbles and reset animation state. Publish if allocation succeeds, then request sound48. Specific visual effect remains unresolved.

units.name: b11_spawn_five_actor_burst
units.summary: Consume flag058B and prepare type6F at its saved position. Initialize a24-tick auxiliary timer, then try five combinations of motion nibbles/facing, publishing each until slots run out. Allocation failure ends the burst without rolling back earlier actors.

units.name: b11_spawn_camera_relative_pair
units.summary: Consume flag0584 and create type68 at camera position plus126,100. Publish a mirrored pair with fixed motion; stages6 and later attempt two additional variants. Each allocation can stop the remaining sequence independently.

units.name: b11_spawn_saved_position_group
units.summary: Consume flag0585, place type68 at saved position plus16,8, initialize animation and publish up to four variants with mirrored flags and changed motion nibbles. Specific effect identity remains uncertain.

units.name: b11_spawn_rotating_position_group
units.summary: Consume flag06A7 and initialize type11 with spawn-recordFF. Rotate through eight camera-relative position/animation/timing presets, attempting three actors in this call; each preset can choose its flag orientation. Stop early on allocation failure.

units.name: b11_publish_working_actor
units.summary: Enable writable cartridge RAM and copy all16 working actor fields into the corresponding parallel16-slot arrays at slot X. Caller has already chosen the free slot; this helper does not allocate or advance it.

units.name: b11_initialize_auxiliary_animation
units.summary: Save PRG-six shadow, map animation bank12, then follow actor-type and state pointers to a four-byte frame record. A nonzero duration supplies frame ticks and sprite pointer, then restores the saved bank. Zero-duration redirects update state/frame and restart at the entry, overwriting the single saved-bank byte; a preserving-return claim therefore requires the nonzero-frame contract, not arbitrary animation data.

units.name: b11_set_actor_motion_low
units.summary: Replace the working actor movement field's low nibble with A while preserving its high nibble. Caller supplies a four-bit value.

units.name: b11_set_actor_motion_high
units.summary: Shift A into the working actor movement high nibble while preserving its low nibble. Caller supplies a four-bit value.

units.name: b11_set_actor_flag_zero
units.summary: Set bit0 of the working actor flags. Its physical orientation meaning is inferred only at the relevant movement/render consumer.

units.name: b11_set_actor_flag_one
units.summary: Set bit1 of working actor flags, preserving all other bits.

units.name: b11_clear_actor_flag_zero
units.summary: Clear bit0 of working actor flags. Burst handlers use this to mirror otherwise matching variants.

units.name: b11_clear_actor_flag_one
units.summary: Clear bit1 of working actor flags, preserving other state.

units.name: b11_find_free_auxiliary_slot
units.summary: Protect cartridge RAM from writes and scan actor slots15 down to1 for a negative type byte. Return X and carry clear on success; carry set means all nonplayer slots are occupied. Slot0 is reserved and never offered.

units.name: b11_submit_auxiliary_sound
units.summary: Write command A to the signed sound mailbox only when idle. Busy requests are discarded; no delivery guarantee is implied by the call.

units.name: b13_apply_camera_vertical_step
units.summary: Respect mode freeze and forced-update bits, then apply vertical camera speed in the direction selected by inhibit bit1. Clip to zero or the stored16-bit maximum by restoring the prior position and reducing speed until valid. Crossing a16-pixel boundary adjusts map origin by one stride; crossing8 pixels requests tile streaming. Scroll Y wraps over224 pixels.

units.name: b13_apply_camera_horizontal_step
units.summary: Apply horizontal speed using direction bit0, clipping against zero or the16-bit horizontal limit. Crossing16 pixels adjusts the map-origin cell; crossing8 pixels requests streaming. Horizontal scroll wraps modulo256 and toggles nametable bit0 on carry/borrow.

units.name: b13_upload_prepared_edge_tiles
units.summary: Require prepared buffers and a tile-stream request. Select vertical PPU increment for the chosen28-byte column half, then horizontal increment for the selected34-byte row half, splitting it at the nametable boundary. This uploads existing bank11 expansion buffers rather than decoding map cells in the interrupt path.

units.name: b13_upload_prepared_edge_attributes
units.summary: When horizontal streaming is active, upload the two split row-attribute segments, then seven column attributes at eight-byte PPU address strides. Caller must already have prepared destinations and staging bytes and entered a safe PPU interval.

units.name: b13_choose_horizontal_camera_speed
units.summary: Boss mode diverts to the fixed-target camera handler. Otherwise select four tracking thresholds from actor orientation, compare actor-camera X, choose left/right direction and derive speed from the actor or tracked actor's movement low nibble. The central threshold band stops horizontal motion.

units.name: b13_choose_vertical_camera_speed
units.summary: Select normal or alternate vertical tracking bands from mode bits, compare actor-camera Y, and approach a target speed derived from the tracked movement high nibble. Direction reversals first halve the existing speed until zero before changing direction; a mode-local gate can suppress the alternate adjustment.

units.name: b13_read_tracked_vertical_speed
units.summary: Return the tracked actor's movement high nibble when a nonnegative tracked slot exists, otherwise use the current working actor. The result is an unsigned speed magnitude.

units.name: b13_approach_boss_camera_target
units.summary: If boss mode is already active, stop both camera speeds. Otherwise move each axis toward the indexed boss target by at most2 pixels, clipping the final step. When both arrive, set boss-mode and related timers/flags and choose one of two sound/transition requests, with optional saved spawn coordinates.

units.name: b13_trigger_player_fall_transition
units.summary: Submit sound26, set animation state through the fixed-bank helper and transfer to player state5. This is the common consequence of the accepted long-fall paths; natural trigger coverage is separate.

units.name: b13_probe_actor_forward_wall
units.summary: Outside boss mode, choose one of two horizontal probe offsets from actor flag bits0/2, sample the collision cache near the lower body and classify the property with the side-contact predicate. Boss mode returns carry clear without a probe.

units.name: b13_clamp_actor_to_boss_region
units.summary: When mode bit40 is set, clamp the actor's low X displacement from the indexed boss origin to the interval43..AD, rebuilding its high coordinate from the same base. Other modes leave it unchanged.

units.name: b13_classify_contact_property
units.summary: Return carry set for supported nonzero ordinary properties or the accepted40-bit property family, excluding its listed special values. Negative properties and excluded/range-outside values return clear. Game-level tile names remain unresolved; callers use only this mechanical predicate.

units.name: b13_classify_side_contact_property
units.summary: Return carry for nonzero side-blocking properties, excluding ordinary property2 and the special40-bit family exceptions. High-bit properties return clear. Preserve this predicate separately from the floor-contact classifier because its exclusions differ.

units.name: b13_probe_actor_floor_support
units.summary: Sample the lower-body cached property and save it as the lower-contact byte. Use the floor predicate first, then if the property is zero test a flagged saved platform/rectangle against actor coordinates. Carry reports support; the geometric fallback does not invent a tile property.

units.name: b13_sample_collision_cache
units.summary: Convert actor subcell position plus X/Y pixel offsets into an index in the local4-column property cache and return that byte. Scratch also retains cell-relative row/column information for later map/world-coordinate reconstruction.

units.name: b13_stop_actor_at_forward_contact
units.summary: Probe the forward wall; when carry is set, invoke the player idle/state-reset helper and return carry set. Otherwise preserve the clear collision result.

units.name: b13_align_actor_y_to_cell
units.summary: Clear the low four bits of actor Y, snapping its low coordinate to a16-pixel cell boundary. High Y is unchanged.

units.name: b13_probe_actor_ceiling
units.summary: Sample the upper body and apply the side-contact predicate. Also treat exact worldY0 as a ceiling boundary. Carry reports a block while leaving other coordinates untouched.

units.name: b13_probe_actor_slope
units.summary: Sample three vertically separated points at the actor center until a high-bit property is found. Return its low seven bits with carry set and a scratch row selector identifying which probe matched; return carry clear when no slope property is present.

units.name: b13_align_actor_to_slope
units.summary: Use slope type and actor X within its16-pixel cell, in two-pixel steps to select a height from the profile table. Replace Y's subcell height, then adjust the16-bit Y cell by plus/minus16 according to the selected probe row and profile high bit. The table encodes the geometry; original terrain names remain uncertain.

units.name: b13_inspect_player_contact_tiles
units.summary: Clear the contact-render flag, probe two upper points when the player's state allows them, then always probe two lower points. Each point delegates special-property handling to the adjacent contact consumer.

units.name: b13_handle_special_contact_property
units.summary: Decode40-bit contact properties into render-contact flags, damage/state gates or mutable map-cell operations. Special9/10 paths check state/cooldown, replace a level cell with a stage lookup value and call the fixed-bank map refresh helper, then optionally save its world position and submit sound. This consumer establishes mechanical property families, not all tile names.

units.name: b13_save_contact_world_position
units.summary: Convert cached cell coordinates into16-pixel offsets relative to the camera-aligned origin, store the16-bit world X/Y and subtract16 from Y. The saved position feeds later effects and map interactions.

units.name: b13_address_cached_map_cell
units.summary: Add the collision-probe column to the saved map-cell base, then add one map stride per probe row, yielding the mutable map-cell pointer. The collision sampler supplies the scratch row/column contract.

units.name: b13_refresh_player_collision_cache
units.summary: Load player slot0 and derive its map pointer, save the cache origin, select the level data bank and protect cartridge RAM. Read three cells in each of four rows through the property lookup into a four-column cache, leaving each fourth column untouched; then inspect special contacts. Cached dimensions and refreshed dimensions are deliberately different.

units.name: b13_find_supporting_actor
units.summary: Scan nonplayer slots15..1 for candidate types below10, excluding selected flag40 cases. The geometry helper discards its immediate return address when support is found, so carry set returns directly to this scan's caller. If no candidate supports the player, clear the tracked slot toFF and return carry clear.

units.name: b13_test_support_actor_geometry
units.summary: Require candidate Y26..33 pixels below the working actor and X within the asymmetric accepted overlap window. On success save its slot, discard this helper's return address, check side obstruction and ceiling interaction, then return carry set to the scan's caller. This nonlocal stack contract must not be modeled as an ordinary helper fallthrough.

units.name: b13_check_support_ceiling_transition
units.summary: For an unflagged support actor, probe the player's upper contact and conditionally start state23 with sound15 and cleared movement/mode bits. The transition path discards two saved return addresses before RTS, deliberately exiting enclosing support/control calls; the ordinary path simply returns.

units.name: b13_check_support_side_obstruction
units.summary: Clear the support-obstruction flag, then inspect a left or right upper/lower probe according to the support actor's movement direction and player-state probe flags. Any blocking floor predicate sets the obstruction byte; zero horizontal support speed needs no probe.

units.name: b13_carry_player_with_support
units.summary: Act only when the currently updating actor is the tracked supporting slot. Start from the player's saved coordinates, apply the platform's signed horizontal movement unless obstructed and position the player32 pixels above it, preserving prior Y on subtraction underflow. Publish the adjusted position to slot0 with cartridge RAM writes enabled.

units.name: b13_test_item_action_capacity
units.summary: Return carry set when a special spawn is pending, item quantity is exhausted or the selected item's actor-count limit is reached. Clear a stale exclusivity flag when no special actors remain. Carry clear permits an action; no item identity is inferred from the table index.

units.name: b13_queue_item_action_state
units.summary: Set the pending-action flag, save discriminator A and enter the shared actor-state setter. The caller supplies the action/state value.

units.name: b13_handle_floor_property_action
units.summary: For property3, gate a one-time mutable-cell operation on cooldown/state, save its map pointer, replace the stage-dependent tile, refresh the map and save the effect world position before sound32. Properties4B..57 instead delegate to a fixed-bank property handler; others return unchanged.

units.name: b13_save_support_cell_position
units.summary: Convert cached cell coordinates to a16-bit world position relative to the camera's16-pixel-aligned origin. This saved support rectangle differs from the adjacent contact effect position and does not subtract a Y cell.

units.name: b13_advance_mutable_floor_effect
units.summary: Dispatch the optional floor-effect phase: phase1 checks a neighboring property, chooses an adjacent map cell, replaces it and advances; phase2 prepares type4D at the saved position, initializes/allocates/publishes it and advances on success. Other phase values do nothing. Bank-return contracts follow the independently reviewed fixed-bank helpers.

units.name: b13_retire_mutable_floor_actor
units.summary: When frame index reaches3, mark the working actor inactiveFF and clear the optional floor-effect phase. Other frames retain both values.

units.name: b13_accept_upward_slope_alignment
units.summary: Save Y, align to the selected slope and accept only a negative16-bit Y displacement. Otherwise restore the old position and return carry clear; accepted alignment returns carry set.

units.name: b13_accept_small_slope_alignment
units.summary: Save Y, align to the slope and accept negative displacement or nonnegative displacement below4 pixels. Larger downward correction restores the original position and returns carry clear.

units.name: b13_test_stage_target_rectangle
units.summary: Compare player slot0 against the stage-indexed target X/Y, requiring both unsigned differences below32 with matching high-byte subtraction. Return carry set only inside that32-by32 rectangle.

units.name: b13_begin_player_damage_state
units.summary: Consume the damage request unless an inhibit/hidden-mode gate blocks it. Set the timed mode bit and state22, initialize recoil/timers/flags, clear tracked support and decrement the last full status cell. These exact effects support a damage interpretation; original state names remain tentative.

units.name: b13_check_player_below_view
units.summary: Unless already state25, compare actor Y with camera Y and enter state25 when outside the accepted192-pixel view band. Initialize its movement/timers and request sound15; exact game consequence is a fall/death hypothesis.

units.name: b13_begin_player_airborne_state
units.summary: Request sound23, clear tracked support, initialize timer11 and auxiliary movement counters, then enter state2 through the shared setter. The following state handlers determine its continuing motion.

units.name: b13_reset_player_motion_and_state
units.summary: Clear both motion components using fixed-bank helpers, then select state0 through the common state setter.

units.name: b13_set_player_state_and_animation
units.summary: Store A as working actor state, reset frame index and tail-call animation initialization. That initializer can remap bank12 and has the nonzero-frame preservation precondition documented at its own contract.

units.name: b13_poll_action_two_edge
units.summary: Report carry set only on the first held frame of the configured action-two button. While held, preserve its latch; after release clear it. The action mask is configurable, so no fixed physical button is assumed.

units.name: b13_poll_action_one_edge
units.summary: Report carry set only for the first held frame of configured action one. Keep the latch while held and clear it on release, independently of action two.

units.name: b13_handle_grounded_player_controls
units.summary: Prioritize a fresh action-one edge if the ceiling is clear, then an action-two item action if capacity permits. Up/Down without horizontal input select mode/state9/10 and a short gate. Left/Right either set horizontal speed2 and state1 or enter a facing-change state24; configured action masks remain independent of physical buttons. Neighboring substates have separately reviewed collision, facing and motion contracts.

units.name: b13_handle_crouched_player_controls
units.summary: Keep the current crouch frame while Down remains held, otherwise request its release frame. At the initial frame permit an action-two item request and horizontal motion only when the facing-side wall probe is clear; otherwise stop horizontal motion. Fresh action one is sampled to maintain its latch even in this state.

units.name: b13_update_player_state_dispatch
units.summary: Load slot0 into the working actor, update camera tracking, process damage/offscreen gates unless mode bit4 bypasses them, and invoke the state word-table entry through a trampoline. Clamp to the boss region and publish the working actor back to slot0 after the handler returns.

units.name: b13_invoke_player_state
units.summary: Jump through the prepared RAM dispatch pointer. The caller's JSR supplies the handler return address; the word table's accepted state domain is separate from this mechanical trampoline.

units.name: b13_maintain_ground_support_with_wall
units.summary: Prefer a supporting actor, otherwise try small slope alignment then ordinary floor support. Probe the facing wall where applicable. Loss of support clears timers/tracked slot and enters airborne state2, adding a boss-mode grace counter when needed.

units.name: b13_round_near_cell_bottom_nonlocal
units.summary: If actor Y subcell position is14 or15, round to the next16-pixel cell and discard this helper's return address before returning from its caller. Other subcell positions return normally. This is intentional nonlocal stack control, not a generic balanced-return helper.

units.name: b13_maintain_ground_support
units.summary: Check actor support, small slope alignment and ordinary floor support. Loss of support enters state2 with cleared timers and optional boss grace; unlike the preceding handler this path omits the facing-wall stop.

units.name: b13_maintain_vertical_mode_support
units.summary: Preserve a supporting actor or align directly to a slope. If ordinary floor support disappears, clear tracked support and vertical-mode bits, reset auxiliary timers and enter airborne state2.

units.name: b13_advance_airborne_support_state
units.summary: A special floor property or tracked support starts a downward-offset motion path. Otherwise try actor/slope/floor support, align on landing, request sound24 and reset to idle. While unsupported, apply vertical motion and increment a fall counter up to32, then take the shared fall transition.

units.name: b13_inactive_player_state_return
units.summary: This state entry intentionally returns immediately without modifying the working actor.

units.name: b13_request_optional_action_on_frame
units.summary: When frame3 has fewer than8 ticks left, set the optional-action flag. Other frames leave it unchanged; the eventual flag consumer determines the game-level action.

units.name: b13_advance_recoil_and_recovery
units.summary: While the recovery gate is clear, branch by actor vertical flag to check ceiling or floor/slope support, update motion/timers and set a recovery flag after contact. Later recovery either clears the timed mode and enters state23 or counts down the status-dependent state timer while maintaining support. Exact damage/status presentation remains tentative.

units.name: b13_advance_two_phase_landing
units.summary: Phase0 checks support, landing and floor-triggered effects; on landing it requests sound25, resets motion, advances frame phase and initializes animation. Unsupported motion uses a four-tick cadence and fall limit. Phase1 maintains support or enters airborne state2 when the floor is lost.

units.name: b13_request_motion_on_animation_frame
units.summary: On frame1 with exactly2 ticks remaining, tail-call the fixed-bank orientation/motion helper. Other animation positions return unchanged.

units.name: b13_advance_simple_fall_state
units.summary: Check actor/slope/floor support; on landing align Y, request sound25 and reset to idle. Otherwise apply the shared vertical-motion helper.

units.name: b13_advance_delayed_action_state
units.summary: Clear horizontal motion and use actor flag1 to choose either a16-tick movement buildup or a timed vertical phase. Apply movement only on a modulo4 cadence; the later phase stops vertical motion at40 ticks and requests the optional action at56.

units.name: b13_advance_slow_airborne_state
units.summary: With flag1 clear, handle ceiling/facing probes and a decrementing motion timer before applying vertical motion every fourth tick. With flag1 set, check actor/slope/floor support, honor the boss grace counter, and on landing reset to idle with sound24. Prolonged unsupported motion takes the shared fall transition.

units.name: b13_advance_timed_airborne_state
units.summary: Use ceiling collision to stop the upward timer, otherwise decrement it and apply a fixed vertical-motion parameter. In the alternate flag direction check actor/slope/floor support, landing with sound24 and idle reset; unsupported motion counts toward the shared fall limit.

units.name: b13_center_player_in_boss_region
units.summary: Unless a grace/state gate blocks it, move player slot0 one pixel horizontally toward boss-origin plus120, with full16-bit carry/borrow. Protect cartridge RAM for inspection and enable writes only while publishing the new coordinate.

units.name: b13_scan_special_level_properties
units.summary: On a pending threshold request and no cooldown, save map origin and begin a13-row scan with a250-tick cooldown. Each later call maps the level bank and examines17 cells in one row through the property lookup; values45..48 create actors via the adjacent consumer. Advance the saved row pointer by stride and decrement remaining rows.

units.name: b13_spawn_level_property_actor
units.summary: Map property45..48 to actor types6A..6D, derive saved coordinates from the map cell and initialize animation/motion. An eight-value phase lookup and property variant select movement/flags and small position offsets. Allocate and publish if capacity permits, then request sound35. All selector/table extents remain those independently accepted in disassembly.

units.name: b13_set_actor_special_ceiling_flag
units.summary: Preserve A while probing two top-edge world positions through the fixed-bank map lookup. Set actor flag20 if either property equals5B; otherwise clear it. The flag name describes the tested property mechanically, not a guessed terrain identity.

units.name: b13_subtract_actor_auxiliary_amount
units.summary: Invoke the fixed-bank preparatory helper, subtract the shared amount from actor auxiliary field0C and call the fixed-bank underflow handler on borrow. Preserve the exact byte arithmetic; its game-level quantity remains unresolved.

units.name: b14_upload_status_rows
units.summary: Defer status writes while either streaming flag is active. Otherwise upload the two24-byte status tile rows at PPU2383/23A3, unless the dirty-cell flag selects the targeted update helper. Safe PPU timing is supplied by the interrupt caller.

units.name: b14_clear_status_tile_buffers
units.summary: Clear both24-byte status rows in RAM; this does not directly update PPU memory.

units.name: b14_initialize_status_tile_buffers
units.summary: Clear the rows, copy fixed label tiles into their left/right groups and render seven score digits plus the saved continue number through the shared paired-digit helper. Table CPU aliases require the current stage-data context.

units.name: b14_update_status_display
units.summary: When gameplay is active and not transitioning, consume60 frame ticks and decrement the timer low component with rollover59, emitting warning sounds near expiration. Render timer, selected-item glyphs, clamped quantity0..99, lives-minus-one and six status cells; partial status cells decay toward zero after their current glyph is selected.

units.name: b14_draw_decimal_pair
units.summary: Divide A into tens/ones by repeated subtraction10 and render each through the paired vertical glyph helper, advancing destination index Y between digits. CPU stack preserves the remainder.

units.name: b14_upload_targeted_map_cells
units.summary: Use three prepared PPU addresses to write two tile pairs and one attribute byte, then clear the dirty-cell flag. These scratch buffers are a map mutation request, distinct from the ordinary status-row upload path.

units.name: b14_dispatch_screen_selector
units.summary: Store selector A, map MMC3 PRG register6/7 values8/9 through the fixed-bank helpers and jump to screen-bank8000. Effective bank context must follow MMC3 mode rather than treating every register value as a physical bank index.

units.name: b14_gameplay_nmi
units.summary: Save registers and mapper shadows, blank rendering and DMA the selected OAM page. Upload palette/CHR state and prepared background/status updates, restore scroll/rendering and schedule raster continuation. Tick camera/timers/palette/controller/background work, restore mapper state and RTI. Existing verified interrupt mechanics are retained; classification does not imply every gameplay path was observed.

units.name: b14_schedule_scroll_split
units.summary: Derive the first split from224-scrollY. Central positions install the ordinary split IRQ; near-boundary positions use a short alternative or skip directly to the status IRQ. Prepare the next latch and nametable address shadows from control/scroll bits. Exact timing constants belong to this engine's raster contract.

units.name: b14_scroll_split_irq
units.summary: Acknowledge IRQ, save A/X, arm the next split and install status IRQ, then use calibrated calls/NOPs before writing the prepared PPU address. Restore registers and RTI. Delay bytes and instruction counts are observable timing behavior.

units.name: b14_status_band_irq
units.summary: Acknowledge IRQ and preserve registers, apply timed CHR/palette/PPU changes for the status band, install the final IRQ and service audio work, then restore registers and RTI. Reuse the prior sound review; do not remove delay instructions or assume general hardware-cycle compatibility.

units.name: b14_update_audio_in_irq
units.summary: If background work needs priority, mark sound deferred. Otherwise temporarily map sound banks10/11, submit the pending request, tick all four channels and consume a deferred extra tick when requested. Restore the prior PRG register values before returning to the raster continuation.

units.name: b14_finish_status_irq
units.summary: Use calibrated raster timing to restore the next band's rendering/control settings, restore saved A and return from interrupt. This entry has an interrupt stack contract, not an ordinary RTS contract.

units.name: b14_raster_delay_long
units.summary: Fall through seven extra NOPs into the shorter delay entry. The exact instruction count plus call overhead is intentional raster timing.

units.name: b14_raster_delay_short
units.summary: Execute the calibrated NOP delay and return. Preserve exact emitted bytes and call/return overhead.

units.name: b14_wait_transition_ticks
units.summary: Wait for five interrupt ticks, decrement the palette-transition counter and repeat until zero. Interrupts must remain active; the caller controls transition direction and initial value.

units.name: b14_tick_game_timers
units.summary: Consume a frame token and advance the screen timer. Unless frozen by mode bit8, increment game/blink/time counters and decrement active mode/word/contact/CHR timers. Expiring the timed mode clears bit1 and requests sound52, subject to the inhibit flag.

units.name: b14_update_game_palette
units.summary: Only rebuild active colors when transition position changes. Position4 copies all32 original colors; lower positions subtract a lookup brightness offset and clamp to0F, higher positions add the selected offset and clamp at30. The full loop now has classified boundaries; game color interpretation beyond these exact mechanics is unnecessary.

units.name: b14_build_stage_background
units.summary: Set map origin to cartridge RAM6000, clear camera/scroll coordinates and the attribute shadow, then derive the first row pointer and map bank11 into A000. For each of14 rows call the bank11 renderer, restore slot1 to13, upload the row and finally upload64 attribute bytes.

units.name: b14_address_map_row
units.summary: Copy map origin into the row pointer and add map stride once per row-index byte, propagating carries. Zero index returns the original pointer.

units.name: b14_clear_attribute_shadow
units.summary: Clear both64-byte halves of the128-byte nametable attribute shadow in RAM. Later row/column patchers merge quadrant fields into it.

units.name: b14_toggle_stage_chr_group
units.summary: When the two-byte countdown expires, reload it with200, toggle a phase bit and select one of two stage-indexed CHR-bank shadows. Nonzero countdown returns without a change.

units.name: b14_animate_secondary_chr_group
units.summary: When its six-tick timer expires, reload it, toggle phase and set CHR shadow1 to the corresponding stage bank plus2. The timer itself is decremented by the game interrupt.

units.name: b14_consume_sound_request
units.summary: Ignore an empty signed mailbox. Gate request groups below/above14 with sound-option bits, then use four parallel tables to start the nonnegative channel commands at sound-bank8003. Mark the request emptyFF afterward; the sound bank must already be mapped.

units.name: b14_select_stage_music_request
units.summary: Choose a boss/region request when boss mode is active, otherwise use the stage request table with a threshold-state exception. Submit through the priority-aware mailbox helper.

units.name: b14_submit_prioritized_sound
units.summary: Requests below17 enter the mailbox directly. Higher requests compare priority against active effect channels and the previous effect request; lower-priority active effects can reject them. The accepted path updates both mailbox and last-effect selector. Preserve the original pending-request comparison flow rather than assuming the final conditional branches reject it.

units.name: b14_restore_saved_effect_position
units.summary: Copy the saved four-byte effect world position into the working actor's X/Y coordinates.

units.name: b14_steer_actor_toward_saved_cell_x
units.summary: Convert actor world X to a16-pixel cell coordinate and compare it with auxiliary field0F plus/minus input tolerance A. Tail-call one of two horizontal-direction helpers when outside the band, otherwise leave direction unchanged.

units.name: b14_horizontal_distance_to_player
units.summary: Protect cartridge RAM, compute the absolute16-bit X distance between working actor and slot0, and return the low byte orFF when outside one-byte range. Y distinguishes which side the player occupies on an in-range result.

units.name: b14_vertical_distance_to_player
units.summary: Protect cartridge RAM and return the absolute Y distance from slot0, saturating toFF when the high-byte difference makes it exceed one-byte range.

units.name: b14_test_actor_overlap_with_slot
units.summary: Y selects the other actor. Compare both16-bit X and Y intervals using type-indexed width/height extents; separation returns carry clear and overlap carry set. Type indices and extent tables obey the independently accepted consumer domain.

units.name: b14_test_actor_overlap_with_player
units.summary: Compare the working type's rectangle with slot0 using type-specific extents. Player state can shrink its effective top boundary and the X test includes an8-pixel inset. Carry set means overlap; separated axes return clear.

units.name: b14_turn_actor_at_forward_obstacle
units.summary: Choose leading edge from orientation, probe the map at Y8, and for tall sprites probe the following map row as well. A blocking property flips horizontal orientation and returns carry set; otherwise carry clear. Level-bank lookup intentionally changes PRG-six state.

units.name: b14_probe_actor_center_property
units.summary: Sample the map at actor offset8,16 and return the common property predicate's carry result.

units.name: b14_lookup_world_tile_property
units.summary: Map the level PRG bank, read one map-cell index through the supplied pointer and translate it through the property lookup. Return A with the level bank active; source pointer and map bounds are caller preconditions.

units.name: b14_turn_actor_at_unsupported_row
units.summary: Advance the existing map pointer one stride, inspect its property with the ordinary solid predicate and flip horizontal orientation when support is absent. Carry set reports that turn.

units.name: b14_turn_actor_at_upper_obstacle
units.summary: Move the map pointer backward one stride, inspect the common blocking predicate and flip horizontal orientation on contact. Carry set reports the change.

units.name: b14_reverse_actor_vertical_on_contact
units.summary: Select a top/bottom probe from flag1, accept only nonzero ordinary properties with neither high flag bit, and choose the opposite vertical direction helper. Carry set indicates contact; other properties leave direction unchanged.

units.name: b14_reverse_actor_horizontal_on_contact
units.summary: Choose actor X offset0 or32 from flag0, sample the top map cell and ignore zero or property5B. Other contacts select the opposite horizontal direction and return carry set.

units.name: b14_consume_actor_interaction
units.summary: Use the contacted actor type minus17 to invoke its interaction word-table handler, request sound30, queue a burst position from that actor, mark its spawn record consumed and retire the actor. The indirect handler must meet its independently reviewed return contract.

units.name: b14_interact_then_probe_upper_left
units.summary: Run player-overlap interaction, then sample actor offset4,0 through the common world-contact helper. The interaction result does not itself prove terrain contact.

units.name: b14_classify_world_property
units.summary: Return carry set for negative properties,5B or nonzero ordinary properties. Zero and other40-bit family values return clear. The exact exceptions distinguish this predicate from the adjacent ordinary-solid test.

units.name: b14_classify_ordinary_solid_property
units.summary: Return carry set only for nonzero properties with both high bits clear. Negative and40-bit special properties return clear.

units.name: b14_request_damage_on_player_overlap
units.summary: Require rectangle overlap and a vulnerable player state, then set the damage request and clear two vertical mode bits. Carry reports an accepted damage request; geometric overlap alone is insufficient.

units.name: b14_test_player_damage_eligibility
units.summary: Reject player states22,23,25 and timed-mode bit1; otherwise return carry set. Cartridge RAM protection is enabled before reading player state.

units.name: b14_scan_spawn_candidates
units.summary: Unless boss mode inhibits spawning, count active types16..63 and compute player cell coordinates. Scan records backward from the saved last index, skipping flagged entries and enforcing a five-actor cap on higher types before proximity checks.

units.name: b14_test_spawn_proximity
units.summary: Require bounded horizontal/vertical cell distance plus edge/mode conditions, then enforce the higher-type threshold/count gate. Decode the selected spawn record into working fields and dispatch its type initializer. For a selected initializer that returns normally, test lifetime, publish and mark the spawn record state2. Some initializers deliberately discard a return address and bypass this continuation.

units.name: b14_initialize_scripted_support_actor
units.summary: Clear the script timer and initialize state0, flags, movement and counters, ending with the selected horizontal orientation. The type-specific behavior begins in the following handler.

units.name: b14_update_scripted_support_actor
units.summary: Initialize its command once through flag80. Command values below9 load motion-table components and tick the script timer;20/40/80 stop motion and wait for selected shared/player-support conditions before fetching another command. Keep command roles mechanical; original platform names are uncertain.

units.name: b14_fetch_actor_motion_command
units.summary: Actor type minus9 selects a command pointer. Read the current cursor into auxiliary field0C; commands below9 consume a following duration, while FF reads a relative backward cursor displacement and repeats. Other commands consume one byte and wait for their handler condition.

units.name: b14_update_support_vertical_drop
units.summary: Wait until the player tracks this actor, then set activation flag80 and sound37. Oscillate vertical direction on an8-tick phase, increasing a timer to48, then set flag40, release tracked support and begin the final downward motion.

units.name: b14_update_support_vertical_excursion
units.summary: Activate on tracked support with sound27. While occupied, move upward for a bounded count; after release reverse for the remembered duration, then clear activation flags and stop. The two actor flags distinguish outbound/return phases.

units.name: b14_update_vertical_contact_actor
units.summary: Set vertical speed1, run vertical contact reversal and return its carry result. Exact terrain/game actor identity remains uncertain.

units.name: b14_update_activated_horizontal_support
units.summary: Activate on tracked support with sound27, then set horizontal speed1 and reverse at a sampled contact. A contact clears activation and stops horizontal motion.

units.name: b14_activate_support_return_motion
units.summary: Wait for tracked support, set activation80 with sound27 and clear its outbound timer, then enter the shared return-motion handler.

units.name: b14_activate_support_on_player_state
units.summary: Require tracked support and player state3/4 before activating and clearing the16-bit travel counter; then enter the shared return-motion handler.

units.name: b14_update_support_outbound_return
units.summary: While outbound, increment a16-bit travel counter and move vertically until support/contact ends. Set flag40 to remember return phase, reverse vertical direction and count back to zero, then clear both high flags and stop.

units.name: b14_activate_contact_gated_support
units.summary: Wait for tracked support, set flag80 with sound27 and clear its16-bit counter. Continuing motion uses the shared handler after the following alternate activation gate.

units.name: b14_activate_contact_support_on_player_state
units.summary: Require tracked support and player state3/4 before sharing the same activation setup. Existing high-bit activation enters the contact-gated motion handler directly.

units.name: b14_update_contact_gated_support_return
units.summary: Use vertical contact tests and tracked-slot state to count outbound travel, reverse after a contact/release and count the travel back. The return can resume outbound motion if its tracked/contact condition changes. Clear activation and stop only after the stored distance is exhausted.

units.name: b14_initialize_timed_facing_actor
units.summary: Set timer32 and state0, clear flags, face toward the player and zero both motion components. Input type and spawn coordinates were prepared earlier.

units.name: b14_decode_spawn_working_coordinates
units.summary: Copy spawn index/type, retain its cell X in auxiliary field0F and expand cell X/Y into16-bit pixel coordinates by shifting left4. The parallel spawn arrays have independently established bounds.

units.name: b14_initialize_variable_delay_actor
units.summary: Choose delay75 for demo mode, otherwise derive a bounded delay from the frame-token low bits, then enter shared state0 initialization. Preserve the original ADC carry contract rather than claiming a uniform random distribution.

units.name: b14_initialize_moving_vertical_actor
units.summary: Clear flags, initialize caller-selected state, face the player and select positive vertical direction, timer32 and motion components1/1.

units.name: b14_initialize_horizontal_actor_clear_timer
units.summary: Clear flags/timer, initialize caller-selected state, face the player and set horizontal speed1 with zero vertical speed.

units.name: b14_initialize_horizontal_actor_variant_one
units.summary: Clear flags, initialize caller-selected state, face the player and set horizontal speed1 with zero vertical speed. Actor type selects its later behavior.

units.name: b14_initialize_horizontal_actor_variant_two
units.summary: Use the same facing and movement initialization for another type-specific entry; the separate entry identity is preserved.

units.name: b14_initialize_stationary_actor
units.summary: Clear flags, initialize caller-selected state, face the player and zero both movement components.

units.name: b14_initialize_horizontal_actor_variant_three
units.summary: Initialize caller-selected state and player-facing orientation, then select horizontal speed1 and zero vertical speed.

units.name: b14_initialize_long_delay_actor
units.summary: Initialize state/facing, set auxiliary fields to44 and1, then horizontal speed1 and zero vertical speed. The two-byte timing interpretation depends on the consuming handler.

units.name: b14_face_actor_toward_player
units.summary: Compare16-bit X with player slot0 and choose the corresponding horizontal orientation helper. No distance clamp is needed for this sign-only comparison.

units.name: b14_advance_ground_patrol_actor
units.summary: Request player interaction, set horizontal speed1 and test forward/underfoot terrain, turning as required. Steer toward a saved cell band; a periodic fixed-bank gate switches to state1 with a long timer. Unsupported continuations retain their accepted exact bounds.

units.name: b14_request_player_interaction_tail
units.summary: Tail-call the common overlap/damage interaction helper.

units.name: b14_activate_actor_on_player_overlap
units.summary: If the shared gate is clear, require overlap, apply a player effect and sound16. Set horizontal speed1, publish the activation byte and initialize state1 through the shared state setter.

units.name: b14_activate_actor_near_player
units.summary: When horizontal player distance is below48, initialize state1; otherwise return unchanged.

units.name: b14_request_player_interaction_return
units.summary: Invoke the overlap/damage helper and return. This separate entry preserves the table's handler identity.

units.name: b14_reset_actor_state_zero
units.summary: Select state0 through the shared working-actor state/animation setter.

units.name: b14_retire_actor_and_release_spawn
units.summary: Enable cartridge RAM writes, mark the working typeFF and clear its saved spawn-record flag so it can be considered again.

units.name: b14_update_timed_projectile_request
units.summary: Check player interaction, hold frame duration10 and face the player. A selected player state redirects this actor's animation; otherwise decrement its timer, advance animation at expiry and queue a projectile request at a facing-dependent offset with the actor's current Y.

units.name: b14_save_projectile_facing_offset
units.summary: Copy orientation bit0 and derive a16-bit projectile X position: actorX-6 or actorX+20. Save the result for the bank11 one-shot spawn consumer.

units.name: b14_save_aimed_projectile_offset
units.summary: Copy orientation bit0 and save actorX or actorX+16 into the alternate projectile request coordinates.

units.name: b14_update_alternate_projectile_request
units.summary: Check interaction/facing and the selected player state. At timer expiry advance animation and queue the ordinary projectile request at the saved facing X and actorY+12, using the same bank11 consumer as the preceding handler.

units.name: b14_actor_interaction_wrapper
units.summary: Invoke the shared overlap/damage helper and return.

units.name: b14_wait_then_enter_actor_state_one
units.summary: Process interaction and facing each tick; when the timer expires reload224 and initialize state1.

units.name: b14_fire_periodic_aimed_projectile
units.summary: Process interaction/facing, decrement timer and every64 ticks save a facing X offset and Y+8 then queue an aimed projectile. At overall expiry reload192 and return to state0.

units.name: b14_activate_and_track_player_actor
units.summary: Activate within96 horizontal pixels, then run a255-tick lifetime. Every8 ticks face the player and select horizontal/vertical movement toward it, with horizontal steering constrained to the saved origin band. Expiry retires and releases the spawn record.

units.name: b14_activate_actor_with_long_timer
units.summary: Within56 horizontal pixels set timer250 and enter state1; outside that band return unchanged.

units.name: b14_advance_timed_horizontal_actor
units.summary: Process interaction and count down its timer, moving horizontally and steering toward a five-cell origin band. At expiry stop horizontally and enter state3.

units.name: b14_empty_actor_handler
units.summary: This handler intentionally returns without changing state.

units.name: b14_reset_actor_after_frame_four
units.summary: Return to state0 once frame index reaches4; earlier animation frames continue unchanged.

units.name: b14_activate_actor_with_short_timer
units.summary: Within80 horizontal pixels set timer80 and enter state1. Other positions retain the current state.

units.name: b14_advance_obstacle_sensitive_actor
units.summary: Process interaction and a timer; while active, test leading/underfoot properties and steer within a ten-cell band with horizontal speed1. Timer expiry stops motion and enters state3; the terrain stop paths retain their separately reviewed nonlocal return contracts.

units.name: b14_retire_actor_tail
units.summary: Tail-call the shared actor retirement/spawn-release helper.

units.name: b14_empty_actor_handler_variant
units.summary: Separate immediate-return entry retained for its handler-table identity.

units.name: b14_test_then_launch_actor
units.summary: Move horizontally while checking overlap. When near and facing the player, derive a six-cell launch area and require the independent floor/clearance test; then initialize upward motion and state1 with a16-tick delay. Otherwise continue obstacle-sensitive patrol.

units.name: b14_test_six_cell_launch_area
units.summary: Map the level data bank. Require six cells in the first row to have property0 and six in the following row to have property4. Carry clear permits the launch; any mismatch returns carry set.

units.name: b14_advance_launch_and_land_actor
units.summary: Set horizontal speed3, process interaction and wait out the initial delay. Apply vertical motion afterward; when moving downward onto a nonzero ordinary floor, align Y, stop vertically and reset to state0.

units.name: b14_advance_timed_patrol_transition
units.summary: Process interaction and forward/upper terrain turning. Decrement an optional transition timer; near the player at expiry stop horizontal movement, clear timers and enter state1 with selected orientation. Otherwise patrol within a five-cell band.

units.name: b14_advance_vertical_phase_actor
units.summary: Set vertical speed2 and hold frame duration10. One direction counts down into a stopped state3 with timer10; the alternate direction uses player interaction/center terrain tests to reverse and grows a bounded counter up to48.

units.name: b14_patrol_with_interaction
units.summary: Process player interaction, forward/underfoot terrain and steer within a ten-cell origin band. Turning helpers preserve their own contact flags.

units.name: b14_patrol_without_interaction
units.summary: Run the same terrain steering with a five-cell band while omitting the overlap/damage request.

units.name: b14_advance_optional_motion_actor
units.summary: Process interaction, periodically toggle a motion direction and steer within its origin band. A shared optional mode adds quarter-rate falling, slow signed X drift and periodic facing changes; a vertical threshold or completion flag transforms it into type4F with reset animation/motion.

units.name: b14_request_vertical_effect_near_player
units.summary: Process interaction and origin-band steering. After cooldown, require at least24 vertical pixels separation and fewer than3 horizontal pixels, then save its position, set a15-tick cooldown and queue the bank11 vertical-effect request.

units.name: b14_consume_optional_actor_count
units.summary: Decrement the shared optional count when nonzero, then tail-call the fixed-bank effect helper with A/X5. This exact tail contract supported the previously unresolved normal-return edge.

units.name: b14_retire_actor_after_frame_four
units.summary: Mark the working typeFF at frame4 or later. Earlier frames remain active.

units.name: b14_advance_boss_effect_grid
units.summary: Require boss/region mode and no completion flag, then build type4E at one of16 offsets from a saved origin. Allocate/publish one actor; advance the grid cursor only on success. After the requested rounds either set completion or dispatch the stage-specific ending continuation. Natural boss completion remains unverified.

units.name: b14_tick_fading_motion_actor
units.summary: Apply vertical motion and decrement lifetime. Expiry retires the actor; each eight-tick boundary reduces the horizontal movement nibble toward zero, preserving its vertical nibble.

units.name: b14_probe_retire_upper_left
units.summary: Request player interaction, then probe offset4,0 and retire the actor when the common property predicate accepts contact.

units.name: b14_probe_retire_lower_left
units.summary: Use the same interaction/contact retirement path at offset4,8.

units.name: b14_probe_retire_middle_left
units.summary: Use the same interaction/contact retirement path at offset0,4.

units.name: b14_probe_retire_middle_right
units.summary: Use the same interaction/contact retirement path at offset8,4.

units.name: b14_retire_actor_on_world_contact
units.summary: Convert caller-provided X/Y offsets to a map pointer, look up the world property and apply the accepted contact predicate. Carry-set contact marks typeFF; otherwise preserve actor type.

units.name: b14_begin_motion_script_after_delay
