units.summary: Decrement the start timer, then initialize state1 and fetch the first motion-script command at zero.

units.name: b14_fetch_effect_motion_script
units.summary: Auxiliary field0E chooses a script pointer; cursor0B reads a motion selector and following duration0C. Reset movement/orientation, then use four parallel selector tables to apply speed/direction from the shared magnitude. A negative selector retires the actor instead of consuming a duration.

units.name: b14_queue_boss_region_auxiliary_actor
units.summary: Require boss/region state, zero item quantity and an unused one-shot flag. Choose request type0 or3 from a shared mode, derive a camera-relative X using an eight-value offset table and Y+192, save coordinates and latch the request for bank11's auxiliary spawn handler.

units.name: b15_reset_entry
units.summary: Initialize stack and mapper selection, reset hardware/RAM, initialize game defaults and configured controls, map sound banks and request screen selector18. Screen18 returns with physical8/9 selected; the continuation displays selectors2,3,14, then enters the screen4 and stage-entry paths.

units.name: b15_request_initial_game_screen
units.summary: Request screen selector4 through the fixed-bank display dispatcher. Screen return leaves physical8/9 selected; continue through the saved-mode notice gate and explicit stage-bank setup.

units.name: b15_gameplay_main_loop
units.summary: Handle demo timeout/Start exit and stage display flags, then consume interrupt-produced frame tokens while building sprites, scanning spawns, refreshing player contacts and updating actors/actions. Use a four-phase scheduler for status/time, stage completion, boss/optional states and pause. Bank11 auxiliary spawn updates are mapped temporarily, restoring bank13 afterward. Existing natural/artificial execution coverage remains separate from this static control-flow review.

units.name: b15_initialize_game_state
units.summary: Clear stage, score, selected-item/quantity and demo/progression bytes; initialize lives and three full status cells to3 while clearing the remaining cells. Set cartridge mirroring and retain configured controls/difficulty as separate initialization state.

units.name: b15_check_stage_boss_boundary
units.summary: On odd stages outside boss mode, compare player X/Y against stage-pair target rectangles. The alternate-region override chooses another target set. Accepted coordinates save the target-table index and enable mode40, resetting related boss/one-shot state where needed. This establishes geometry, not natural boss-defeat reachability.

units.name: b15_handle_pause_start
units.summary: On Start, submit the stop sound request, freeze gameplay mode and darken the palette while building the pause status display. Require release, new press and release of Start, then rebuild normal status, restore palette/mode and clear accumulated frame work.

units.name: b15_shut_down_stage_display
units.summary: Mark transition mode, stop camera speeds and wait through the interrupt-driven fade. Submit/acknowledge the zero sound request, disable interrupts/rendering, clear scroll and active boss/mode flags and disable mapper IRQ. Return with display shut down.

units.name: b15_check_stage_completion
units.summary: Accept an explicit completion flag or stage-exit rectangle, shut down the display and increment stage. Stage14 requests screen0; selected difficulty/stage boundaries request alternate screens, otherwise screen6. The terminal pair12/7 tails to startup; other accepted screen continuations rejoin stage entry. Natural ending/credits reachability remains unverified.

units.name: b15_handle_expired_stage_timer
units.summary: Return while timer remains nonzero. On expiry submit/acknowledge stop and warning commands, stop camera motion and wait150 frame ticks, then request the player transition, set timer to one high unit and raise the stage-threshold flag.

units.name: b15_handle_player_restart_request
units.summary: Consume a pending transition by shutting down display, restoring three full status cells and clearing transient camera/action/damage state. Decrement lives; nonzero lives enter the accepted stage-map setup prefix, while zero lives requests screen1. The accepted restart continuation rebuilds the stage at saved player position; the continue transition either restarts the menu stack or replenishes resource slots.

units.name: b15_add_decimal_score_digits
units.summary: Add A to score digit X, subtract10 and propagate carry toward more significant indices until the digit fits. Caller supplies a valid decimal digit array index and a bounded addend.

units.name: b15_load_actor_working_copy
units.summary: X selects slot0..15. Copy sixteen fields from parallel cartridge-RAM arrays into the working actor: type,16-bit X/Y, sprite pointer, flags, animation state/frame/timing, motion and auxiliary bytes. Preserve slot identity in the caller's state.

units.name: b15_store_actor_working_copy
units.summary: Enable cartridge-RAM writes and publish all16 working fields to the corresponding parallel arrays at slot X. Update the RAM-protection shadow; no ROM backing changes.

units.name: b15_actor_offset_to_map_pointer
units.summary: Add caller X/Y pixel offsets to working actor world coordinates, divide each by16 and form6000+column+row*map_stride using16-bit shift/add arithmetic. Column is truncated to eight bits, so valid map width is a caller constraint. Return the pointer in shared work scratch.

units.name: b15_prepare_actor_metasprite
units.summary: Convert actor world position to camera-relative coordinates and reject offscreen origins. Type tables select sprite dimensions and CHR bits; the current animation pointer supplies a header and tile/attribute pairs. Choose normal or mirrored grid traversal, with the1x1 fast path when applicable. Game-level artwork identities remain unresolved.

units.name: b15_render_normal_grid
units.summary: Traverse columns and rows using type-selected pixel offsets, skip zero/offscreen tiles and append four-byte OAM entries to the inactive page. Exhausting the sprite capacity stops emission; apply a per-object CHR-shadow update at exit when its header requests one.

units.name: b15_render_mirrored_grid
units.summary: Traverse columns backward and XOR hardware attribute bit40 while consuming the same tile stream. Preserve page selection, clipping and capacity handling; mirroring changes placement and sprite flip together.

units.name: b15_build_sprite_frame
units.summary: Map sprite-data bank12, select the inactive OAM page and reset its64-sprite capacity. Prioritize player/selected actor, traverse other slots in alternating order to share overflow, hide unused entries and publish the completed DMA page. Mapping and object-buffer state are explicit outputs.

units.name: b15_select_animation_frame
units.summary: Save PRG-six shadow, map bank12 and resolve type to state to four-byte frame record. Nonzero duration sets frame ticks/sprite pointer and restores the saved bank. Zero duration redirects state/frame and restarts at the entry, overwriting the single saved-bank byte; preserving-return contracts therefore require the independently supported nonzero-frame precondition.

units.name: b15_update_one_actor
units.summary: Load selected slot, advance animation, invoke its type/state handler, apply movement and lifetime checks, publish fields, then update tracked-platform carrying. Called handlers and bank return context must satisfy their separately reviewed contracts.

units.name: b15_schedule_actor_updates
units.summary: Always update slot0 and the tracked supporting slot, then round-robin through other active slots while frame-work budget permits. Skip slot0 in the rotating cursor and preserve the next slot when backlog requires yielding.

units.name: b15_tick_actor_animation
units.summary: Decrement frame ticks; on zero advance frame index and resolve its next animation record. A valid nonzero starting tick count is part of the animation contract.

units.name: b15_set_actor_horizontal_speed
units.summary: Replace the movement low nibble with A while preserving the vertical high nibble. Caller supplies a four-bit speed.

units.name: b15_set_actor_vertical_speed
units.summary: Shift A into the movement high nibble while preserving its low nibble. Caller supplies a four-bit speed.

units.name: b15_flip_actor_horizontal_direction
units.summary: Toggle actor flag0, preserving all other flag bits.

units.name: b15_flip_actor_vertical_direction
units.summary: Toggle actor flag1, preserving other flags.

units.name: b15_select_actor_negative_x_direction
units.summary: Set flag0. Horizontal movement is negative in the ordinary mode; flag2 reverses that interpretation in the movement consumer.

units.name: b15_select_actor_positive_y_direction
units.summary: Set flag1, selecting positive vertical movement in the common movement consumer.

units.name: b15_select_actor_positive_x_direction
units.summary: Clear flag0, selecting positive horizontal movement unless flag2 reverses it.

units.name: b15_select_actor_negative_y_direction
units.summary: Clear flag1, selecting upward/negative vertical movement.

units.name: b15_tick_actor_word_counter
units.summary: Subtract one from auxiliary fields0B/0C as a16-bit countdown. Return carry set at exact zero, clear otherwise. Starting at zero wraps; callers supply a positive countdown.

units.name: b15_apply_actor_vertical_acceleration
units.summary: Preserve horizontal speed. In positive-Y direction increase vertical speed toward4; in negative-Y direction decrease it to zero, then flip to positive-Y. This implements the engine's bounded gravity-like motion without claiming physical units beyond pixels per update.

units.name: b15_move_actor_from_nibbles
units.summary: Ignore inactive types or zero motion. Apply low-nibble X and high-nibble Y speeds with16-bit carry/borrow; flag0 chooses X direction with flag2 reversal, flag1 chooses Y direction. Clamp upward Y at zero, preserving exact unsigned arithmetic.

units.name: b15_dispatch_actor_state
units.summary: Types40..4C can wait on a countdown or derive motion relative to the camera before ordinary dispatch. Low nonplayer types also update a special terrain flag. Resolve type to state word table and jump through the RAM pointer; accepted table extents come from independent structural review, not arbitrary selector values.

units.name: b15_scale_relative_coordinate
units.summary: Use caller carry and the shared low byte to shift a relative16-bit coordinate into the returned byte. This small helper preserves the exact ROR/LSR sequence used by the special actor motion path.

units.name: b15_find_free_actor_slot
units.summary: Protect cartridge RAM and scan slots15 down to1 for a negative type byte. Return X/carry clear on success, carry set when full; slot0 remains reserved.

units.name: b15_retire_out_of_range_actor
units.summary: Apply type-specific player/camera distance rules, spawn flags and boss exceptions. Retire out-of-range actors with typeFF, clear appropriate spawn-state bits and decrement the special actor count for its defined classes. Boss-region cases can clear the one-shot spawn latch; preserve these distinctions rather than applying a universal offscreen rule.

units.name: b15_render_fixed_four_tiles
units.summary: For low actor types, subtract camera coordinates and emit up to four table-defined tiles/attributes with clipping into the inactive OAM page. This fixed layout bypasses animation tile records but still consumes the shared sprite capacity.

units.name: b15_render_single_tile
units.summary: Check camera-relative coordinate high bytes and visible height, emit one tile/attribute pair into the selected OAM page, advance its cursor and apply the optional CHR-shadow request. This is the1x1 fast path of the metasprite renderer.

units.name: b15_process_pending_item_action
units.summary: Consume a pending item request, decrement quantity/increment the active special count when an item is selected, choose a type-specific action word and prepare the discriminator/working field before indirect dispatch. Supported normally returning handlers continue through lifetime/publication and request bookkeeping atEDAB. Nonlocal handler exits have separate stack contracts.

units.name: b15_initialize_stationary_item_actor
units.summary: Set frame0, derive player-relative position/facing, request sound17 and initialize type60 with zero motion and positive Y direction. The later handler determines its active behavior.

units.name: b15_set_item_position_from_player
units.summary: Choose Y offset4 or16 from the action discriminator, copy player facing and use a frame-indexed X offset to position the item on the facing side. Set vertical flag1 for the resulting working actor.

units.name: b15_initialize_fast_item_actor
units.summary: Position beside the player at Y+6 or18 and facing-side X offset, request sound18, set horizontal speed8/vertical0 and initialize type61 state0.

units.name: b15_tick_item_retirement_nonlocal
units.summary: For nonzero auxiliary field0E discard the immediate caller return address, apply vertical acceleration and decrement lifetime0F. Expiry retires typeFF and decrements the special count. The RTS returns beyond the usual item handler call; zero field0E returns normally.

units.name: b15_update_delayed_item_actor
units.summary: Apply the nonlocal lifetime gate, decrement the start timer and stop vertical speed at expiry, then share actor/terrain collision handling with the following item entry.

units.name: b15_update_item_actor_contacts
units.summary: Apply the item lifetime gate, test overlap with eligible actors and leading terrain, retiring and decrementing the special count on accepted contact.

units.name: b15_update_player_attached_item
units.summary: Recompute the item's player-relative position each tick, process actor/terrain contact and retire after frame4 while clearing the priority render slot. It remains mechanically attached rather than using ordinary movement alone.

units.name: b15_initialize_three_variant_item
units.summary: Build a fast type61 at the player's facing side, then publish successive variants when slots permit, changing motion/type for64 and66. Increment the expected special count twice, request sound22 and retain allocation failure behavior exactly; partial publication is possible.

units.name: b15_initialize_arcing_item_type62
units.summary: Create type62 at the player-relative offset, request sound19, select horizontal speed6 and positive vertical speed5, then initialize its animation/state.

units.name: b15_initialize_arcing_item_type63
units.summary: Create type63 at the player-relative offset, request sound20, select horizontal speed6 and positive vertical speed6, then initialize animation/state.

units.name: b15_update_arcing_item_contacts
units.summary: Apply lifetime gate and eligible-actor collision, then vertical acceleration and terrain contact. Accepted contact retires the item and decrements the active special count.

units.name: b15_update_item_ground_effect_request
units.summary: Apply lifetime/actor collision and acceleration, then test terrain. On selected ordinary floor properties2/4, save its aligned position and queue a later special spawn before retiring/decrementing the item. Other contacts only retire it.

units.name: b15_probe_item_leading_terrain
units.summary: Choose X/Y leading probe offsets from type extents and facing flags, map the world property and invoke the shared item property handler. The handler can discard this helper's return address to return carry set to its caller; normal completion returns carry clear.

units.name: b15_handle_item_world_property_nonlocal
units.summary: Zero properties return normally. Negative/ordinary solid properties discard the immediate return address and return carry set; selected40-bit properties4B..57 can queue a collectible request, replace the level cell, prepare its map refresh and save world position before the same nonlocal exit. The PLA/PLA atF14A belongs to this routine, not toF14E.

units.name: b15_prepare_mutated_map_upload
units.summary: Save the replacement metatile index, map the level bank, expand its four tile bytes and derive the cell's PPU tile/attribute destinations. Retry coordinate preparation if the frame-work counter changes, then set the dirty-upload flag. This routine ends with the balanced RTS atF172; its returned bank context is the level bank.

units.name: b15_collect_timed_mode_item
units.summary: Require overlap with player slot0, set the timed mode and inhibit timer, mark the pickup consumed through auxiliary field0E and request sound14. No overlap leaves state unchanged.

units.name: b15_collect_item_selection_one
units.summary: On player overlap save the previous selection, select item1 and reset exclusivity when it changes. Load difficulty-dependent quantity, mark consumed, clear the boss one-shot latch and request sound31.

units.name: b15_collect_item_selection_two
units.summary: On overlap select item2 with the same previous-selection/exclusivity contract and its difficulty-dependent quantity, then mark consumed and request sound31.

units.name: b15_collect_item_selection_three
units.summary: On overlap select item3, set difficulty-dependent quantity, preserve previous-selection/exclusivity bookkeeping and mark consumed with sound31.

units.name: b15_collect_item_selection_four
units.summary: On overlap select item4 with its difficulty-dependent quantity, clear the boss one-shot latch and mark consumed with sound31.

units.name: b15_collect_one_status_cell
units.summary: On player overlap refill one status cell through the shared helper, mark the pickup consumed and request sound40.

units.name: b15_collect_three_status_cells
units.summary: On player overlap refill three status cells, mark consumed and request sound40.

units.name: b15_collect_all_status_cells
units.summary: On overlap request up to six full status cells, mark consumed and request sound40.

units.name: b15_collect_continue_counter
units.summary: On player overlap increment the saved continue-number byte, mark the pickup consumed and request sound41. Exact presentation is retained as a tentative continue interpretation.

units.name: b15_collect_extra_life
units.summary: On overlap increment remaining lives, mark the pickup consumed and request sound40.

units.name: b15_collect_stage_time
units.summary: On overlap add20 to the low timer component, roll at60 into its high component, mark consumed and request sound46. This is base60 timing, not packed BCD.

units.name: b15_refill_status_cells
units.summary: Scan six status cells left to right, setting nonfull cells to3 until input count X is exhausted or the array ends. Already-full cells do not consume the count.

units.name: b15_collect_second_tally_resource
units.summary: On overlap increment the second tally resource, mark consumed and request sound38. The precise inventory identity remains unresolved.

units.name: b15_collect_first_tally_resource
units.summary: On overlap increment the first tally resource, mark consumed and request sound39. It is distinct from the second resource's tally scale.

units.name: b15_expand_mutation_tile_record
units.summary: Multiply the replacement metatile index by4, add its tile-record base and copy the four tile bytes into the prepared upload scratch. This helper changes scratch addresses, not the structural map.

units.name: b15_locate_mutation_relative_cell
units.summary: Subtract map origin from a map-cell pointer. Reject negative difference with carry set; otherwise divide the offset by map stride through repeated subtraction, returning cell column/row in scratch with carry clear.

units.name: b15_save_mutation_world_position
units.summary: Convert the relative cell coordinates to16-pixel offsets from camera-aligned world origin and save16-bit X/Y for the later auxiliary spawn request.

units.name: b15_locate_mutation_ppu_tiles
units.summary: Combine relative map cell with scroll and nametable bits, wrap rows over14 metatiles and calculate the PPU tile address using the row destination table. Preserve the derived cell row/column for attribute patching.

units.name: b15_patch_mutation_attribute_shadow
units.summary: Compute PPU attribute address and quadrant from the derived cell. Merge the replacement metatile's two-bit attribute into the128-byte shadow with quadrant masks, save the upload byte and derive the second tile-row destination32 bytes later.

units.name: b15_test_item_against_actor_slots
units.summary: Scan nonplayer actors15..1 for eligible types17..63, applying the special exclusion for type60. Require rectangle overlap, then dispatch the contacted actor's interaction; return its accepted carry result or clear after the full scan.

units.name: b15_process_pending_special_actor
units.summary: Consume the pending-position flag and prepare type6E with fixed motion/animation at that location. Attempt to allocate/publish a pair with opposite horizontal orientation, incrementing special count only for successful allocations. Allocation failure can leave a single published actor.

units.name: b15_update_special_actor_contacts
units.summary: Check eligible actor overlap and leading terrain; otherwise probe its center floor property and stop horizontal movement on an accepted ordinary floor. Retire on contact or final animation frame and decrement the special count. Exact contact paths preserve the current nonlocal helper contracts.

units.name: b15_tick_short_lived_actor
units.summary: Decrement auxiliary timer0B and mark typeFF when it reaches zero. Other fields remain unchanged.

units.name: b15_periodic_boss_dispatch
units.summary: While boss mode is active in the first region, decrement its timer and every40 ticks select a stage-pair handler through the accepted boss word table. The indirect trampoline uses bank13; supported handler contracts are structural rather than universal natural-reachability claims.

units.name: b15_boss_pattern_magnitude_three
units.summary: Set shared pattern magnitude3 and enter the common boss pattern producer.

units.name: b15_boss_pattern_magnitude_two
units.summary: Set shared pattern magnitude2 and share the same boss pattern producer.

units.name: b15_produce_boss_pattern_actor
units.summary: Increment the pattern count; at10 leave boss mode and reset sound state. Otherwise choose type25, rotate one of four selector positions, save its script index and derive X/Y from the first coordinate-table pair before shared actor publication.

units.name: b15_publish_boss_pattern_actor
units.summary: Zero movement, initialize state0/animation and timer16, then allocate/publish the working actor when capacity permits. Allocation failure returns without a published record.

units.name: b15_rotate_boss_pattern_selector
units.summary: Increment the pattern selector modulo4, returning the selected value in A/X and storing it for paired pattern producers.

units.name: b15_set_boss_relative_actor_x
units.summary: Add unsigned offset A to the indexed boss-origin X with16-bit carry and store working actor X. Y remains the saved target-table index for the paired Y helper.

units.name: b15_set_boss_relative_actor_y
units.summary: Add unsigned offset A to the indexed boss-origin Y with carry and store working actor Y.

units.name: b15_produce_paired_boss_pattern25
units.summary: Set magnitude2 and increment the ten-pattern sequence. Choose two table-driven type25 positions with script indices4..11, publishing each independently. Sequence completion shares the boss-exit transition; allocation can produce only part of the pair.

units.name: b15_produce_boss_pattern27
units.summary: Set magnitude3, count the pattern and build type27 at one of four table-selected positions with script indices12..15, then use the shared publication helper.

units.name: b15_produce_boss_pattern28
units.summary: Set magnitude3 and build type28 using the next coordinate-table pair and script indices16..19, respecting the same ten-pattern completion gate.

units.name: b15_produce_paired_boss_pattern26
units.summary: Set magnitude3 and build two type26 variants from the paired coordinate tables with script indices4..11. Each allocation is independent, and the ten-pattern gate can exit boss mode.

units.name: b15_update_boss_three_auxiliary_sequence
units.summary: Process player overlap, then use the shared boss phase: wait, queue three auxiliary actors and switch vertical motion; after the next wait stop, and after all auxiliaries finish reset the phase. While auxiliaries remain, compare player screen X against a moving threshold every fourth tick and publish slow signed X drift. The following fixed-bank effect entries restore saved player position and publish types24/23 under lifetime checks.

units.name: b15_update_boss_wait_phase
units.summary: Clear the shared variant flag, apply periodic vertical bobbing and decrement the timer. Choose state1 or2 with timer64 based on the shared boss phase; phase4 enters the shared boss-retirement continuation.

units.name: b15_update_boss_request_group_phase
units.summary: Set the shared variant flag, bob vertically and process overlap. At timer expiry either return to state0 after32 ticks or advance the shared phase, reload64 and request the saved-position auxiliary group. Phase4 retires through the shared continuation.

units.name: b15_choose_next_boss_position
units.summary: Stop vertical speed and wait out the timer. Then clear the shared phase, rotate one of four camera-relative coordinate pairs, save/restore that position into the actor and initialize state0. Phase4 retires instead of repositioning.

units.name: b15_bob_boss_vertical_motion
units.summary: Set vertical speed1 and toggle vertical direction whenever the actor timer low3 bits are zero. The caller owns timer decrementing and overall state progression.

units.name: b15_update_boss_horizontal_sweep
units.summary: Process overlap and use the shared phase to accelerate horizontal speed at16-tick intervals, reverse at camera-relative horizontal bounds, pause16 ticks and restart with speed1. Other phase values retire through the shared boss continuation.

units.name: b15_update_boss_descent_and_group_request
units.summary: Process overlap, stop initial descent at a boss-origin-relative Y threshold, then advance timed phases. The second phase queues a camera-relative auxiliary group; later phases select state1 and eventually the retirement continuation.

units.name: b15_update_boss_centering_pause
units.summary: Process overlap and center the player within the boss region. Use a modulo4 auxiliary counter to pace a countdown, then choose shared phase1, timer64 and state0. Shared phase4 retires.

units.name: b15_dispatch_boss_rectangular_sweep
units.summary: Process overlap and dispatch the shared phase. Phase0 moves vertically between relative Y bounds32/100, counts down and advances. Later phases approach a chosen Y endpoint, sweep to left/right X boundaries and reset direction/timer. Unsupported phase values use the shared retirement continuation.

units.name: b15_approach_boss_sweep_y
units.summary: Set vertical speed2, force even Y and move toward the selected boss-origin-relative Y endpoint32 or100. At the endpoint stop Y, set horizontal speed2, advance phase and choose the positive-X orientation.

units.name: b15_finish_boss_left_sweep
units.summary: Compare boss-relative X with64. At or left of that boundary advance the phase, set horizontal speed2 and select the opposite horizontal direction.

units.name: b15_finish_boss_right_sweep
units.summary: When boss-relative X reaches176, clamp to the exact16-bit boundary, stop X, reset shared phase and choose the next vertical endpoint from a frame-indexed table. Reload timer64 and restore its initial horizontal orientation.

units.name: b15_retire_boss_and_begin_effect_grid
units.summary: Save current boss position as the effect-grid origin, mark the working actor inactive, increment the boss-completion latch, clear grid completion and request three effect-grid rounds with sound13. This accepted producer connects to bank14's grid handler; natural defeat/credits remain unverified.

units.name: b15_test_stage_timer_threshold
units.summary: On even stages compare both timer components against parallel stage-indexed thresholds. Equality increments the stage-threshold flag and requests sound5. The precise game-level trigger name remains tentative.

units.name: b15_draw_vertical_digit
units.summary: Map digit A to consecutive tile numbers2*A+1 and2*A+2, storing the upper/lower tiles in the status row buffers at Y.

units.name: b15_initialize_hardware_and_ram
units.summary: Disable rendering/IRQs/APU frame interrupt, set PPU latch/mirroring defaults and clear zero page plus selected RAM pages, leaving stack/sound pages outside that loop. Wait for VBlank samples, install interrupt/control defaults and black palettes, initialize empty sound mailbox and sound-option bits. This native reconstruction makes no general hardware compatibility claim.

units.name: b15_initialize_black_palette
units.summary: Fill both32-byte active/original palette buffers with0F. Later transitions read the original buffer and write the active one.

units.name: b15_initialize_irq_vector
units.summary: Install default RAM IRQ targetFB74. The installed body acknowledges/disables the MMC3 IRQ and RTI.

units.name: b15_select_prg_register_six
units.summary: Preserve A while selecting MMC3 register6 and writing A as its bank value. Update the selected-register shadow; callers maintain the PRG-six bank shadow separately.

units.name: b15_select_prg_register_seven
units.summary: Preserve A while selecting MMC3 register7 and writing A as its bank value. The caller maintains its bank shadow and effective physical context.

units.name: b15_initialize_sound_banks
units.summary: Map PRG register values10/11, call sound-bank initialization at8000 and return. Effective physical bank identities are provided by the accepted caller context, not assumed for every mapper mode.

units.name: b15_read_game_controller
units.summary: Latch eight serial bits into held-buttons RAM. In demo mode, Start records an exit request; active gameplay substitutes timed script input, while transitional modes suppress held input. Expired demo input saves the previous8000 bank on stack, maps physical8, fetches an input/duration pair and restores the saved bank before return.

units.name: b15_audio_irq_jump
units.summary: Fixed-bank jump trampoline to the raster/audio service helper. Caller stack contract follows that service.

units.name: b15_nmi_indirect_vector
units.summary: Jump through the RAM NMI continuation pointer installed by the active display mode. Hardware has already pushed interrupt state before this vector trampoline.

units.name: b15_irq_indirect_vector
units.summary: Jump through the RAM IRQ continuation pointer selected by the current raster phase. Do not confuse this CPU alias with a physical ROM target until its installed pointer and banks are known.

units.name: b08_match_timed_controller_sequence
units.summary: Use A as the number of sixty-tick input windows; zero wraps to256 windows. Compare current input with adjacent masks: repeating the current prefix is ignored, the next mask advances the prefix, and any other input resets it. Completing five transitions sets the completion flag and queues request24. Clear the per-poll latch while waiting on the interrupt timer. Natural use of this matcher is unresolved.

units.name: b08_finish_alternate_screen_nmi
units.summary: Continue the installed screen NMI with X=0 established by its prefix. Write CHR registers0..5, set the fixed scroll/mask/control state, refresh glyphs and timers, service the fixed sound hook, then restore saved A/X/Y and RTI. These mapper writes select CHR only. The following9057 RTI is the separately installed empty screen IRQ.

units.name: b08_relocated_request_code_template
units.summary: Static relocated counterpart of fixed-bank CD6A: test the signed request and enable bits, index four adjacent52-byte translation arrays, skip negative entries, load X=0..3, then reset the request toFF. Structural correspondence establishes copied code only. Here every JSR8003 enters bank8 screen initialization; working sound submission, a caller, safe return context and natural execution are unresolved. Do not infer soundbank10 or functional equivalence from the copied instructions.

units.name: b11_enter_row_renderer
units.summary: Tail-enter the row renderer atAC5F. Caller must have actual physical bank11 atA000; the fixed stage row builder provides this mapping.

units.name: b11_enter_map_lz_decoder
units.summary: Tail-enter the map LZ decoder atB187 with source/output pointers prepared. Stage loading maps source bank0 for stage0 and decoder bank11, then restores slot1 to13 after return.

units.name: b11_toggle_player_horizontal_facing
units.summary: Toggle bit0 of the player orientation byte and return. This changes the horizontal facing component without altering bit1.

units.name: b11_toggle_player_vertical_facing
units.summary: Toggle bit1 of the player orientation byte and return, preserving horizontal facing.

units.name: b13_settle_camera_at_player
units.summary: Subtract85/87 pixels from the player's X/Y to form camera targets, clamp negative targets to zero and upper targets against stage extent minus2. Wait for NMI latch4A before updating axis progress flags and seven-step requests; repeat until both axes settle. Interrupt service and initialized stage extents are required. Artificial castle evidence confirms the wait mechanics, not boss reachability.

units.name: b13_update_player_ground_turn
units.summary: Check vertical and horizontal collision helpers, tail into the appropriate recovery path when blocked, then respond to left/right input relative to horizontal facing. A turn resets the speed selection and enters state18; otherwise continue the common player-state path.

units.name: b13_update_player_action_orientation
units.summary: Set movement duration10 and dispatch by vertical facing. Releasing the configured action mask clears its latch and animation state. Resolve collisions before interpreting left/right: blocked contact chooses movement12, turns use the common facing helper, and clear side probes select speed2; otherwise stop horizontal speed.

units.name: b13_update_player_crouched_action
units.summary: Resolve vertical/horizontal contact and enter movement12 when required. Input20 selects state3. Unless the shared lock is set, left/right input and facing choose a turn or a side-probe-gated speed2; no direction stops horizontal speed.

units.name: b13_update_player_input10_state
units.summary: On blocking contacts clear mode bit10 and enter collision recovery. Releasing input10 clears that bit and rejoins the common state path. Otherwise set duration10 and call the turn helper only when left/right input conflicts with current facing.

units.name: b13_update_player_input20_state
units.summary: On the first contact run the action check; a selected command or pending request clears mode bit20 and enters state6. Resolve the other contact, then releasing input20 clears that mode and exits through the common state path. Held input sets duration10 where appropriate and turns only against current facing.

units.name: b13_update_player_timed_side_motion
units.summary: Run the contact update. While the movement selector is nonzero, releasing input20 reduces duration to1. Otherwise set duration10, resolve collision recovery, then choose facing and probe for left/right motion. A clear side selects speed2 and state2; blocked or absent input stops speed.

units.name: b13_update_player_state4_or_side_motion
units.summary: Resolve contacts before input. Input20 selects state4; left/right choose facing and a side probe, then speed2/state2 on a clear result. With neither successful direction, stop horizontal speed.

units.name: b13_update_player_slow_side_motion
units.summary: Choose left/right facing and side-probe-gated speed1, or stop when neither direction can move. This shares the same orientation/probe mechanics as the adjacent faster motion states.

units.name: b13_player_substate_noop
units.summary: Return immediately for no-op entries in the26-word player-substate dispatch table atBA03. BA4C indexes player substate0508, not the actor type0500.

units.name: b14_stage_optional_noop
units.summary: Called by stage initialization after status/OAM setup; this installed optional hook currently returns immediately.

units.name: b14_service_timed_screen_irq
units.summary: Acknowledge/disable the MMC3 IRQ, save A/X/Y, compute the split-screen PPU address, delay by the configured count and clear PPUMASK before joining the shared interrupt restoration atC634. Installed by the screen IRQ-vector writers; NOP spacing is timing-sensitive.

units.name: b14_wait_four_stage_timer_steps
units.summary: Reset the interrupt timer and wait until it reaches5, then increment the stage counter. Repeat until that counter reaches4. Requires the active interrupt timer to advance; the caller initializes the counter.

units.name: b14_reset_stage_runtime_flags
units.summary: Clear stage transient requests, camera progress, counters and shared effect state; install sentinelFF values and initial camera flags. Set the default PPU control/mask shadows, enable interrupts and return. Interrupt vectors must already be installed.

units.name: b14_initialize_stage_systems
units.summary: Install the empty IRQ, disable display shadows and clear input/effect requests. Derive stage parity, load stage metadata and map data, build background/status/OAM, then initialize player position and the optional hook. Finish with the stage countdown set to200. Source and decoder mappings change inside the helpers.

units.name: b14_load_stage_metadata
units.summary: Index the14-stage parallel metadata arrays to obtain CHR selectors, camera extents, source banks, compressed-map pointer tables, palette and spawn pointers. Stage index must be in0..13; these are physical PRG bank selections, not CPU addresses.

units.name: b14_load_stage_palette_and_spawns
units.summary: Map the metadata bank and copy32 palette bytes while setting the first palette shadow to0F. Reset camera/score progress and enable cartridge RAM writes. Parse eight-byte spawn records into state/type and X/Y cell arrays; packed coordinates are shifted right4. Advance the record pointer by8 and stop when the saved first byte minus1 equalsFE. The two final records are excluded from the active count.

units.name: b14_decode_stage_map
units.summary: Map the stage's compressed source bank (stage0 uses physical0), load its source pointer and set output to6000. Enable cartridge RAM, map decoder bank11 intoA000 and call its LZ entryA406. Restore bank13 after return, then fill four pages following the decoded output with the stage-specific boundary value. Unrelated slot context is not assumed.

units.name: b14_finish_background_row_loop
units.summary: With slot1 still physical11, call row-renderer entryA403. Only after CABF's mapper helper returns is slot1 restored to13. Upload the row, increment the row index and repeat until14 rows; finally upload64 attribute bytes.

units.name: b14_upload_stage_background_row
units.summary: Compute nametable destination2000+64*row and upload32 bytes from each half of the row staging buffer, skipping its two-byte gap. Pack pairs of two-bit palette values into attribute bytes: even rows set the low nibble, odd rows merge the high nibble. Fourteen rows feed the shared64-byte attribute staging block.

units.name: b14_upload_stage_attributes
units.summary: Reset the PPU address latch and copy64 staged attribute bytes to23C0. Rendering must be disabled or otherwise allow this direct PPU upload.

units.name: b14_reset_stage_oam_and_actor_slots
units.summary: Hide both256-byte OAM buffers withF8, enable cartridge RAM and set the first16 actor type slots toFF. This initializes staging and free-slot sentinels before player publication.

units.name: b14_clear_stage_status_and_counters
units.summary: Set direct PPU addressing, clear the64-byte nametable status area at2380 and clear48 shared stage-counter bytes. Called during stage construction and restart.

units.name: b14_load_player_stage_spawn
units.summary: Read stage-indexed X/Y spawn components into the working player position and its saved restart copy, then fall through to player state initialization. Stage metadata bank13 must be mapped.

units.name: b14_initialize_player_state
units.summary: Reset player type, motion/animation counters, substate0508 and movement selector; initialize facing to1. Resolve animation throughE8D0, then publish to player slot0 throughE4E6. E8D0/B676's saved-bank restoration requires a selected nonzero frame duration; recursive zero-duration restart is outside that ordinary-return contract.

units.name: b14_finish_selected_actor_initializer
units.summary: After a supported normally returning selected initializer, test lifetime; expired actors rejoin retirement, otherwise publish the actor. Mark its spawn record state2 and restore cartridge-RAM protection. Other selected initializers may take deliberate nonlocal exits.

units.name: b14_mark_spawn_and_abort_caller
units.summary: Temporarily enable cartridge RAM, mark the selected spawn state2, restore protection, discard one stacked return address and RTS to the enclosing caller. This is a nonlocal exit, not an ordinary return witness.

units.name: b14_handle_player_effect_window
units.summary: Accept shared states2/3 and decrement the effect timer. Expiry enters state4, sets the mode flag and awards score; accepted paths queue request30, increment the event counter and save player position. Discard the immediate caller's return address before returning carry set. Rejected states also discard that return address and return carry clear.

units.name: b14_handle_early_effect_window
units.summary: For shared states1/2 join the timer/effect path atDCB8. Other states discard one return address and return carry clear; this handler deliberately exits its caller.

units.name: b14_handle_enabled_effect_window
units.summary: A nonzero enable flag joinsDCB8's timer/effect path. Otherwise discard one stacked return address and return carry clear, bypassing the immediate caller.

units.name: b14_score_nonempty_actor_property
units.summary: A nonzero actor property other than4 tails to the score helper with A/X5. Otherwise discard the caller return address and return carry clear. The score alternative and the nonlocal rejection path have different stack contracts.

units.name: b14_handle_property_or_player_type
units.summary: A nonzero actor property tails to score5. For an empty property, player types61..66 increment the auxiliary state, set timer18 and configure speed/animation/facing. Other types skip those changes. The empty-property path discards the immediate return address and returns carry clear.

units.name: b14_score_actor_property_two
units.summary: Property2 tails to score5. Otherwise discard one caller return address and return carry clear; do not model this rejection as a normal return.

units.name: b14_score_actor_property_one
units.summary: Property1 tails to score5. Otherwise discard one caller return address and return carry clear.

units.name: b14_begin_long_effect_state20
units.summary: Set effect timer30, then join state20 initialization. The adjacent short entry uses15 ticks.

units.name: b14_begin_effect_state20
units.summary: Set timer15 and a shared15-tick interval, clear the resource state, restore saved player position and enter type20 with stopped motion and default facing. Clear shared effect state, set substate20 and derive a parity bit from the frame counter. Publish only if lifetime remains active.

units.name: b14_begin_effect_state21
units.summary: Set timer15, restore saved position and enter type21 with zero horizontal speed, vertical speed3 and the alternate facing. Clear shared effect state, select substate20 and publish only while lifetime remains active.

units.name: b14_begin_effect_state22
units.summary: Set timer10, restore saved position and enter type22 with zero horizontal speed, vertical speed1 and alternate facing. Clear effect/one-shot state, select substate10 and publish only when lifetime remains active.

units.name: b15_show_intro_screen_sequence
units.summary: Display screen selectors2,3,14 in sequence before rejoining startup. Each screen dispatcher maps physical8/9; return context comes from that screen contract, not a pre-call player bank.

units.name: b15_choose_start_screen_sequence
units.summary: Clear the restart flag. A saved mode skips the notices; otherwise display selectors10,9,5 before stage setup. Returning screen calls leave physical8/9 selected.

units.name: b15_start_stage_runtime
units.summary: Select physical bank13 atA000, initialize stage systems, install the stage interrupt setup and reset runtime flags. Settle the camera at the player, update actors/sound, wait for stage timing and prepare the first frame. A restart flag installs a100-tick delay and mode bit2. Source-bank changes inside stage loading are retained; unrelated banks across arbitrary calls are not presumed preserved.

units.name: b15_show_terminal_pair_then_restart
units.summary: Display selectors12 and7, then jump back to the main startup entry. These screen returns use banks8/9; this source contract does not establish naturally reached credits.

units.name: b15_restart_from_terminal_branch
units.summary: Tail to the startup entry after the enclosing terminal-state branch.

units.name: b15_resume_notice_sequence
units.summary: Tail into the stage-entry screen5 path atE053; its dispatcher installs screen banks8/9.

units.name: b15_rebuild_stage_at_saved_position
units.summary: Clear OAM/actors, reload palette/spawns and status area, restore saved player coordinates and initialize player state. Increment restart mode and rejoin stage setup atE062; bank13 metadata and the animation helper's nonzero-frame precondition are required.

units.name: b15_finish_life_or_continue_transition
units.summary: With no saved continue count, show selector7, reset the CPU stack and MMC3 CHR selection, run the transition helpers and restart atE037. Otherwise decrement lives, reset four resource slots to3, clear continuation flags and rejoin screen5. Screen return context is physical8/9: FAD5 only selects register0 and does not remap PRG.

units.name: b15_finish_auxiliary_actor_update
units.summary: After the selected actor returns normally, test lifetime and publish if active. If the shared request is set while the stage gate is clear, consume that request and increment the pending counter. Deliberate nonlocal selected handlers are outside this normal-return continuation.

units.name: b15_save_auxiliary_slot_index
units.summary: Store X as the selected auxiliary actor slot and return; reached from the preceding zero-request branch. The next bytes are five dispatch words, not instructions.

units.name: b15_begin_effect_state24
units.summary: Set timer20, restore saved position and enter type24 with horizontal speed2, vertical speed0 and default facing. Clear effect state, select substate10 and publish only if lifetime remains active.

units.name: b15_begin_effect_state23
units.summary: Set timer25, restore saved position and enter type23 with cleared auxiliary/speed fields and the selected facing. Clear effect state, select substate20 and publish only while lifetime remains active.

units.name: b15_award_score_five
units.summary: Set A/X5 and tail to the common decimal-score helper. Its ordinary score return remains distinct from adjacent nonlocal actor paths.

units.name: b15_service_empty_stage_irq
units.summary: Acknowledge/disable the MMC3 IRQ and RTI. Installed by FB69 through the immutable interrupt trampoline.

units.name: b15_fetch_demo_input_pair
units.summary: Entered after FBEB saves the previous8000 bank on stack and maps physical8. Read input and duration from the two-byte script record, update current/demo input and advance the pointer by2. Pop the saved bank, restore it throughFB78 and RTS. Arbitrary entry without that saved stack byte is unsupported.

units.name: b08_controller_sequence_masks
units.summary: Six ordered controller masks. The matcher compares mask[X] and mask[X+1] for X0..4; repeating the current mask is ignored and only the next mask advances. Natural selection is unresolved.

units.name: b08_relocated_template_arrays
units.summary: Four52-byte translation arrays contain small channel indices withFF skip holes, followed by14 small parameter bytes. Their operands relocate the fixed-bank request template; this supports structure, not a working bank8 sound path. Original use remains unresolved.

units.name: b10_channel_enable_masks
units.summary: Four channel masks1,2,4,8; bank10 setup ORs the selected byte into the enable field. Independent8052 code fixes the endpoint.

units.name: b13_player_substate_handler_words
units.summary: 26 little-endian player-substate handler words. BA4C reads0508 and doubles it to index low/high bytes; repeated BA02 entries return without work. Bank13 mapping and valid substate are required.

units.name: b14_request_priority_parameters
units.summary: 53 signed request-priority/parameter bytes. Fixed queue comparisons atCDED/CDF3/CDFD/CE05 consume them;FF and signed values retain their consumer-specific meaning. NextCE47 is the independent saved-position routine.

units.name: b14_auxiliary_spawn_offsets
units.summary: Eight camera-relative X offsets selected by frame counter AND7 in the auxiliary actor request builder. The following DFAB entry independently fixes the endpoint.

units.name: b14_bank_tail_zero_data
units.summary: Eight uniform zero bytes at the physical bank14 endpoint. No conflicting code entry was found; original padding purpose is unresolved.

units.name: b15_difficulty_parameters
units.summary: Four adjacent three-byte difficulty parameter arrays. Item paths F1B1/F1E3/F210/F23D select their respective array; exact game-level quantities remain uncertain.

units.name: b15_item_action_words
units.summary: Five little-endian item action words selected by ED90/ED96. The preceding EDC7 RTS and following EDD2 handler establish independent boundaries.

units.name: b15_item_position_offsets
units.summary: Five small position offsets; EE2C subtracts and EE3F adds the selected component when placing item effects. Exact item identity remains uncertain.

units.name: b15_actor_coordinate_and_handler_tables
units.summary: Ten four-byte boss coordinate component arrays atFC18..FC3F use the modulo4 selector. FC40..FC6F are24 interaction words; FC70..FCA9 are29 initializer words; FCAA..FCB7 are seven stage-pair effect words. Indirect consumers and accepted targets establish these records; handler-specific stack exits remain explicit. NextFCB8 independently begins the boss table.
